decls.sig: theorem cRank_submatrix {m₀ : Type um} {n : Type un} [Semiring R] (A : Matrix m n R) (em : m₀ ≃ m) (en : n₀ ≃ n) : cRank (A.submatrix em en) = cRank A
decls.doc: A special case of `lift_cRank_submatrix` for when the row types are in the same universe.

decls.name: Matrix.lift_cRank_reindex
decls.sig: theorem lift_cRank_reindex {n : Type un} [Semiring R] (A : Matrix m n R) (em : m ≃ m₀) (en : n ≃ n₀) : lift.{um} (cRank (A.reindex em en)) = lift.{um₀} (cRank A)

decls.name: Matrix.cRank_reindex
decls.sig: theorem cRank_reindex {m₀ : Type um} {n : Type un} [Semiring R] (A : Matrix m n R) (em : m ≃ m₀) (en : n ≃ n₀) : cRank (A.reindex em en) = cRank A
decls.doc: A special case of `lift_cRank_reindex` for when the row types are in the same universe.

decls.name: Matrix.eRank_submatrix
decls.sig: theorem eRank_submatrix {n : Type un} [Semiring R] (A : Matrix m n R) (em : m₀ ≃ m) (en : n₀ ≃ n) : eRank (A.submatrix em en) = eRank A

decls.name: Matrix.eRank_reindex
decls.sig: theorem eRank_reindex {m₀ : Type um} {n : Type un} [Semiring R] (A : Matrix m n R) (em : m ≃ m₀) (en : n ≃ n₀) : eRank (A.reindex em en) = eRank A

decls.name: Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin
decls.sig: theorem rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin [Finite m] [DecidableEq n] {M₁ M₂ : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] (A : Matrix m n R) (v₁ : Basis m R M₁) (v₂ : Basis n R M₂) : A.rank = finrank R (LinearMap.range (toLin v₂ v₁ A))
decls.doc: The rank of a matrix equals the dimension of the range of the corresponding linear map, and is therefore independent of the choice of bases.

decls.name: Matrix.rank_le_card_height
decls.sig: theorem rank_le_card_height [Fintype m] [CommSemiring R] [StrongRankCondition R] (A : Matrix m n R) : A.rank ≤ Fintype.card m

decls.name: Matrix.rank_le_card_of_support_subset
decls.sig: theorem rank_le_card_of_support_subset [CommSemiring R] [StrongRankCondition R] (A : Matrix m n R) (s : Finset m) (hz : Function.support A.row ⊆ s) : A.rank ≤ s.card
decls.doc: The rank of a matrix is at most the size of any finset containing all its nonzero rows.

decls.name: Matrix.rank_le_height
decls.sig: theorem rank_le_height [CommSemiring R] [StrongRankCondition R] {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) R) : A.rank ≤ m

decls.name: Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_cols
decls.sig: theorem rank_eq_finrank_span_cols [CommSemiring R] (A : Matrix m n R) : A.rank = finrank R (Submodule.span R (Set.range A.col))
decls.doc: The rank of a matrix is the rank of the space spanned by its columns.

decls.name: Matrix.cRank_toNat_eq_rank
decls.sig: theorem cRank_toNat_eq_rank [CommSemiring R] (A : Matrix m n R) : A.cRank.toNat = A.rank

decls.name: Matrix.eRank_toNat_eq_rank
decls.sig: theorem eRank_toNat_eq_rank [CommSemiring R] (A : Matrix m n R) : A.eRank.toNat = A.rank

decls.name: Matrix.rank_diagonal
decls.sig: theorem rank_diagonal [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq R] (w : m → R) : (diagonal w).rank = Fintype.card {i // (w i) ≠ 0}
decls.doc: The rank of a diagonal matrix is the count of non-zero elements on its main diagonal

decls.name: Matrix.exists_rank_normal_form
decls.sig: theorem exists_rank_normal_form [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (M : Matrix m m R) : ∃ (V U : Matrix m m R) (e : m ≃ Fin M.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card m - M.rank)), IsUnit V ∧ IsUnit U ∧ V * M * U = (fromBlocks 1 0 0 0).submatrix e e
decls.doc: Every square matrix over a field can be brought, by left and right multiplication by invertible matrices, into the block form `fromBlocks 1 0 0 0`, where the identity block has size equal to the rank of the matrix.

decls.name: Matrix.cRank_diagonal
decls.sig: theorem cRank_diagonal [DecidableEq m] (w : m → R) : (diagonal w).cRank = lift.{uR} #{i // (w i) ≠ 0}

decls.name: Matrix.eRank_diagonal
decls.sig: theorem eRank_diagonal [DecidableEq m] (w : m → R) : (diagonal w).eRank = {i | (w i) ≠ 0}.encard

decls.name: Matrix.ker_mulVecLin_conjTranspose_mul_self
decls.sig: theorem ker_mulVecLin_conjTranspose_mul_self (A : Matrix m n R) : LinearMap.ker (Aᴴ * A).mulVecLin = LinearMap.ker (mulVecLin A)

decls.name: Matrix.rank_conjTranspose_mul_self
decls.sig: theorem rank_conjTranspose_mul_self (A : Matrix m n R) : (Aᴴ * A).rank = A.rank

decls.name: Matrix.rank_conjTranspose
decls.sig: theorem rank_conjTranspose (A : Matrix m n R) : Aᴴ.rank = A.rank
decls.doc: TODO: prove this in greater generality.

decls.name: Matrix.rank_self_mul_conjTranspose
decls.sig: theorem rank_self_mul_conjTranspose (A : Matrix m n R) : (A * Aᴴ).rank = A.rank

decls.name: Matrix.ker_mulVecLin_transpose_mul_self
decls.sig: theorem ker_mulVecLin_transpose_mul_self (A : Matrix m n R) : LinearMap.ker (Aᵀ * A).mulVecLin = LinearMap.ker (mulVecLin A)

decls.name: Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self
decls.sig: theorem rank_transpose_mul_self (A : Matrix m n R) : (Aᵀ * A).rank = A.rank

decls.name: Matrix.rank_transpose
decls.sig: theorem rank_transpose [Field R] [Fintype m] (A : Matrix m n R) : Aᵀ.rank = A.rank

decls.name: Matrix.rank_self_mul_transpose
decls.sig: theorem rank_self_mul_transpose [Field R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [Fintype m] (A : Matrix m n R) : (A * Aᵀ).rank = A.rank

decls.name: Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_row
decls.sig: theorem rank_eq_finrank_span_row [Field R] [Finite m] (A : Matrix m n R) : A.rank = finrank R (Submodule.span R (Set.range A.row))
decls.doc: The rank of a matrix is the rank of the space spanned by its rows.

decls.name: LinearIndependent.rank_matrix
decls.sig: theorem _root_.LinearIndependent.rank_matrix [Field R] [Fintype m] {M : Matrix m n R} (h : LinearIndependent R M.row) : M.rank = Fintype.card m

decls.name: Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_rank_eq_card
decls.sig: theorem mulVec_surjective_iff_rank_eq_card [Field R] [Fintype m] {M : Matrix m n R} : M.mulVec.Surjective ↔ M.rank = Fintype.card m
decls.doc: `M.mulVec` is surjective iff `M` has full row rank.

decls.name: LinearIndependent.mulVec_surjective
decls.sig: theorem _root_.LinearIndependent.mulVec_surjective [Ring R] [IsSemisimpleRing R] {M : Matrix m n R} (h : LinearIndependent R M.row) : M.mulVec.Surjective
decls.doc: A matrix over a semisimple ring with linearly independent rows has surjective `mulVec`.

decls.name: Matrix.vecMul_surjective_iff_rank_eq_card
decls.sig: theorem vecMul_surjective_iff_rank_eq_card [Field R] [Fintype m] {M : Matrix m n R} : M.vecMul.Surjective ↔ M.rank = Fintype.card n
decls.doc: `M.vecMul` is surjective iff `M` has full column rank.

decls.name: LinearIndependent.vecMul_surjective
decls.sig: theorem _root_.LinearIndependent.vecMul_surjective [CommRing R] [IsSemisimpleRing R] [Fintype m] {M : Matrix m n R} (h : LinearIndependent R M.col) : M.vecMul.Surjective
decls.doc: A matrix with linearly independent columns has surjective `vecMul`.

decls.name: Matrix.rank_add_rank_le_card_of_mul_eq_zero
decls.sig: lemma rank_add_rank_le_card_of_mul_eq_zero [Field R] [Finite l] [Fintype m] {A : Matrix l m R} {B : Matrix m n R} (hAB : A * B = 0) : A.rank + B.rank ≤ Fintype.card m

decls.name: Matrix.rank_vecMulVec.
decls.sig: theorem Matrix.rank_vecMulVec.{u} {K m n : Type u} [CommRing K] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (w : m → K) (v : n → K) : (Matrix.vecMulVec w v).toLin'.rank ≤ 1

decls.name: Matrix.reindexAddEquiv
decls.sig: def reindexAddEquiv (eₘ : m ≃ m') (eₙ : n ≃ n') : Matrix m n R ≃+ Matrix m' n' R where
decls.doc: `Matrix.reindex` as an `AddEquiv` between `R`-matrices.

decls.name: Matrix.coe_reindexAddEquiv
decls.sig: theorem coe_reindexAddEquiv (eₘ : m ≃ m') (eₙ : n ≃ n') : ⇑(reindexAddEquiv R eₘ eₙ) = reindex eₘ eₙ

decls.name: Matrix.toEquiv_reindexAddEquiv
decls.sig: theorem toEquiv_reindexAddEquiv (eₘ : m ≃ m') (eₙ : n ≃ n') : (reindexAddEquiv R eₘ eₙ : Matrix m n R ≃ Matrix m' n' R) = reindex eₘ eₙ

decls.name: Matrix.symm_reindexAddEquiv
decls.sig: theorem symm_reindexAddEquiv (eₘ : m ≃ m') (eₙ : n ≃ n') : (reindexAddEquiv R eₘ eₙ).symm = reindexAddEquiv R eₘ.symm eₙ.symm

decls.name: Matrix.reindexAddEquiv_refl_refl
decls.sig: theorem reindexAddEquiv_refl_refl : reindexAddEquiv R (.refl m) (.refl n) = .refl _

decls.name: Matrix.reindexAddEquiv_trans_reindexAddEquiv
decls.sig: theorem reindexAddEquiv_trans_reindexAddEquiv (e₁ : m ≃ m') (e₂ : n ≃ n') (e₁' : m' ≃ m'') (e₂' : n' ≃ n'') : .trans (reindexAddEquiv R e₁ e₂) (reindexAddEquiv R e₁' e₂') = reindexAddEquiv R (.trans e₁ e₁') (.trans e₂ e₂')

decls.name: Matrix.reindexRingEquiv
decls.sig: def reindexRingEquiv (e : m ≃ n) : Matrix m m R ≃+* Matrix n n R where
decls.doc: `Matrix.reindex` as a `RingEquiv` between `R`-matrices.

decls.name: Matrix.coe_reindexRingEquiv
decls.sig: theorem coe_reindexRingEquiv (e : m ≃ n) : ⇑(reindexRingEquiv R e) = reindex e e

decls.name: Matrix.toEquiv_reindexRingEquiv
decls.sig: theorem toEquiv_reindexRingEquiv (e : m ≃ n) : (reindexRingEquiv R e : Matrix m m R ≃ Matrix n n R) = reindex e e

decls.name: Matrix.toAddEquiv_reindexRingEquiv
decls.sig: theorem toAddEquiv_reindexRingEquiv (e : m ≃ n) : reindexRingEquiv R e = reindexAddEquiv R e e

decls.name: Matrix.symm_reindexRingEquiv
decls.sig: theorem symm_reindexRingEquiv (e : m ≃ n) : (reindexRingEquiv R e).symm = reindexRingEquiv R e.symm

decls.name: Matrix.reindexRingEquiv_refl
decls.sig: theorem reindexRingEquiv_refl : reindexRingEquiv R (.refl n) = .refl _

decls.name: Matrix.reindexRingEquiv_trans_reindexRingEquiv
decls.sig: theorem reindexRingEquiv_trans_reindexRingEquiv (e : m ≃ n) (e' : n ≃ o) : .trans (reindexRingEquiv R e) (reindexRingEquiv R e') = reindexRingEquiv R (.trans e e')

decls.name: Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv
decls.sig: def reindexLinearEquiv (eₘ : m ≃ m') (eₙ : n ≃ n') : Matrix m n A ≃ₗ[R] Matrix m' n' A where
decls.doc: The natural map that reindexes a matrix's rows and columns with equivalent types, `Matrix.reindex`, is a linear equivalence.

decls.name: Matrix.coe_reindexLinearEquiv
decls.sig: theorem coe_reindexLinearEquiv (eₘ : m ≃ m') (eₙ : n ≃ n') : ⇑(reindexLinearEquiv R A eₘ eₙ) = reindex eₘ eₙ

decls.name: Matrix.toEquiv_reindexLinearEquiv
decls.sig: theorem toEquiv_reindexLinearEquiv (eₘ : m ≃ m') (eₙ : n ≃ n') : (reindexLinearEquiv R A eₘ eₙ : Matrix m n A ≃ Matrix m' n' A) = reindex eₘ eₙ

decls.name: Matrix.toAddEquiv_reindexLinearEquiv
decls.sig: theorem toAddEquiv_reindexLinearEquiv (eₘ : m ≃ m') (eₙ : n ≃ n') : reindexLinearEquiv R A eₘ eₙ = reindexAddEquiv A eₘ eₙ

decls.name: Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_apply
decls.sig: theorem reindexLinearEquiv_apply (eₘ : m ≃ m') (eₙ : n ≃ n') (M : Matrix m n A) : reindexLinearEquiv R A eₘ eₙ M = reindex eₘ eₙ M

decls.name: Matrix.symm_reindexLinearEquiv
decls.sig: theorem symm_reindexLinearEquiv (eₘ : m ≃ m') (eₙ : n ≃ n') : (reindexLinearEquiv R A eₘ eₙ).symm = reindexLinearEquiv R A eₘ.symm eₙ.symm

decls.name: Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_refl_refl
decls.sig: theorem reindexLinearEquiv_refl_refl : reindexLinearEquiv R A (Equiv.refl m) (Equiv.refl n) = LinearEquiv.refl R _

decls.name: Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_trans_reindexLinearEquiv
decls.sig: theorem reindexLinearEquiv_trans_reindexLinearEquiv (e₁ : m ≃ m') (e₂ : n ≃ n') (e₁' : m' ≃ m'') (e₂' : n' ≃ n'') : (reindexLinearEquiv R A e₁ e₂).trans (reindexLinearEquiv R A e₁' e₂') = (reindexLinearEquiv R A (e₁.trans e₁') (e₂.trans e₂') : _ ≃ₗ[R] _)

decls.name: Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_comp
decls.sig: theorem reindexLinearEquiv_comp (e₁ : m ≃ m') (e₂ : n ≃ n') (e₁' : m' ≃ m'') (e₂' : n' ≃ n'') : reindexLinearEquiv R A e₁' e₂' ∘ reindexLinearEquiv R A e₁ e₂ = reindexLinearEquiv R A (e₁.trans e₁') (e₂.trans e₂')

decls.name: Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_comp_apply
decls.sig: theorem reindexLinearEquiv_comp_apply (e₁ : m ≃ m') (e₂ : n ≃ n') (e₁' : m' ≃ m'') (e₂' : n' ≃ n'') (M : Matrix m n A) : (reindexLinearEquiv R A e₁' e₂') (reindexLinearEquiv R A e₁ e₂ M) = reindexLinearEquiv R A (e₁.trans e₁') (e₂.trans e₂') M

decls.name: Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_one
decls.sig: theorem reindexLinearEquiv_one [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq m'] [One A] (e : m ≃ m') : reindexLinearEquiv R A e e (1 : Matrix m m A) = 1

decls.name: Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_mul
decls.sig: theorem reindexLinearEquiv_mul [Fintype n] [Fintype n'] (eₘ : m ≃ m') (eₙ : n ≃ n') (eₒ : o ≃ o') (M : Matrix m n A) (N : Matrix n o A) : reindexLinearEquiv R A eₘ eₙ M * reindexLinearEquiv R A eₙ eₒ N = reindexLinearEquiv R A eₘ eₒ (M * N)

decls.name: Matrix.mul_reindexLinearEquiv_one
decls.sig: theorem mul_reindexLinearEquiv_one [Fintype n] [DecidableEq o] (e₁ : o ≃ n) (e₂ : o ≃ n') (M : Matrix m n A) : M * (reindexLinearEquiv R A e₁ e₂ 1) = reindexLinearEquiv R A (Equiv.refl m) (e₁.symm.trans e₂) M

decls.name: Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv
decls.sig: def reindexAlgEquiv (e : m ≃ n) : Matrix m m A ≃ₐ[R] Matrix n n A where
decls.doc: For square matrices with coefficients in an algebra over a commutative semiring, the natural map that reindexes a matrix's rows and columns with equivalent types, `Matrix.reindex`, is an equivalence of algebras.

decls.name: Matrix.coe_reindexAlgEquiv
decls.sig: theorem coe_reindexAlgEquiv (e : m ≃ n) : ⇑(reindexAlgEquiv R A e) = reindex e e

decls.name: Matrix.toEquiv_reindexAlgEquiv
decls.sig: theorem toEquiv_reindexAlgEquiv (e : m ≃ n) : (reindexAlgEquiv R A e : Matrix m m A ≃ Matrix n n A) = reindex e e

decls.name: Matrix.toAddEquiv_reindexAlgEquiv
decls.sig: theorem toAddEquiv_reindexAlgEquiv (e : m ≃ n) : reindexAlgEquiv R A e = reindexAddEquiv A e e

decls.name: Matrix.toRingEquiv_reindexAlgEquiv
decls.sig: theorem toRingEquiv_reindexAlgEquiv (e : m ≃ n) : reindexAlgEquiv R A e = reindexRingEquiv A e

decls.name: Matrix.toLinearEquiv_reindexAlgEquiv
decls.sig: theorem toLinearEquiv_reindexAlgEquiv (e : m ≃ n) : reindexAlgEquiv R A e = reindexLinearEquiv R A e e

decls.name: Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv_apply
decls.sig: theorem reindexAlgEquiv_apply (e : m ≃ n) (M : Matrix m m A) : reindexAlgEquiv R A e M = reindex e e M

decls.name: Matrix.symm_reindexAlgEquiv
decls.sig: theorem symm_reindexAlgEquiv (e : m ≃ n) : (reindexAlgEquiv R A e).symm = reindexAlgEquiv R A e.symm

decls.name: Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv_refl
decls.sig: theorem reindexAlgEquiv_refl : reindexAlgEquiv R A (Equiv.refl m) = AlgEquiv.refl

decls.name: Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv_trans_reindexAlgEquiv
decls.sig: theorem reindexAlgEquiv_trans_reindexAlgEquiv (e : m ≃ n) (e' : n ≃ o) : .trans (reindexAlgEquiv R A e) (reindexAlgEquiv R A e') = reindexAlgEquiv R A (.trans e e')

decls.name: Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv_mul
decls.sig: theorem reindexAlgEquiv_mul (e : m ≃ n) (M : Matrix m m A) (N : Matrix m m A) : reindexAlgEquiv R A e (M * N) = reindexAlgEquiv R A e M * reindexAlgEquiv R A e N

decls.name: Matrix.det_reindexLinearEquiv_self
decls.sig: theorem det_reindexLinearEquiv_self [CommRing R] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (e : m ≃ n) (M : Matrix m m R) : det (reindexLinearEquiv R R e e M) = det M
decls.doc: Reindexing both indices along the same equivalence preserves the determinant. For the `simp` version of this lemma, see `det_submatrix_equiv_self`.

decls.name: Matrix.det_reindexAlgEquiv
decls.sig: theorem det_reindexAlgEquiv (B : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (e : m ≃ n) (A : Matrix m m B) : det (reindexAlgEquiv R B e A) = det A
decls.doc: Reindexing both indices along the same equivalence preserves the determinant. For the `simp` version of this lemma, see `det_submatrix_equiv_self`.

decls.name: Matrix.replicateCol
decls.sig: def replicateCol (ι : Type*) (w : m → α) : Matrix m ι α
decls.doc: `Matrix.replicateCol ι u` is the matrix with all columns equal to the vector `u`. To get a column matrix with exactly one column, `Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) u` is the canonical choice.

decls.name: Matrix.replicateCol_apply
decls.sig: theorem replicateCol_apply {ι : Type*} (w : m → α) (i) (j : ι) : replicateCol ι w i j = w i

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow
decls.sig: def replicateRow (ι : Type*) (v : n → α) : Matrix ι n α
decls.doc: `Matrix.replicateRow ι u` is the matrix with all rows equal to the vector `u`. To get a row matrix with exactly one row, `Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) u` is the canonical choice.

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow_apply
decls.sig: theorem replicateRow_apply (v : n → α) (i : ι) (j) : replicateRow ι v i j = v j

decls.name: Matrix.vecMulVec_one
decls.sig: theorem vecMulVec_one [MulOneClass R] (x : n → R) : vecMulVec x 1 = replicateCol m x

decls.name: Matrix.one_vecMulVec
decls.sig: theorem one_vecMulVec [MulOneClass R] (x : n → R) : vecMulVec 1 x = replicateRow m x

decls.name: Matrix.replicateCol_injective
decls.sig: theorem replicateCol_injective [Nonempty ι] : Function.Injective (replicateCol ι : (m → α) → Matrix m ι α)

decls.name: Matrix.replicateCol_inj
decls.sig: @[simp] theorem replicateCol_inj [Nonempty ι] {v w : m → α} : replicateCol ι v = replicateCol ι w ↔ v = w

decls.name: Matrix.replicateCol_zero
decls.sig: @[simp] theorem replicateCol_zero [Zero α] : replicateCol ι (0 : m → α) = 0

decls.name: Matrix.replicateCol_eq_zero
decls.sig: @[simp] theorem replicateCol_eq_zero [Zero α] [Nonempty ι] (v : m → α) : replicateCol ι v = 0 ↔ v = 0

decls.name: Matrix.replicateCol_add
decls.sig: theorem replicateCol_add [Add α] (v w : m → α) : replicateCol ι (v + w) = replicateCol ι v + replicateCol ι w

decls.name: Matrix.replicateCol_smul
decls.sig: theorem replicateCol_smul [SMul R α] (x : R) (v : m → α) : replicateCol ι (x • v) = x • replicateCol ι v

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow_injective
decls.sig: theorem replicateRow_injective [Nonempty ι] : Function.Injective (replicateRow ι : (n → α) → Matrix ι n α)

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow_inj
decls.sig: @[simp] theorem replicateRow_inj [Nonempty ι] {v w : n → α} : replicateRow ι v = replicateRow ι w ↔ v = w

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow_zero
decls.sig: @[simp] theorem replicateRow_zero [Zero α] : replicateRow ι (0 : n → α) = 0

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow_eq_zero
decls.sig: @[simp] theorem replicateRow_eq_zero [Zero α] [Nonempty ι] (v : n → α) : replicateRow ι v = 0 ↔ v = 0

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow_add
decls.sig: theorem replicateRow_add [Add α] (v w : m → α) : replicateRow ι (v + w) = replicateRow ι v + replicateRow ι w

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow_smul
decls.sig: theorem replicateRow_smul [SMul R α] (x : R) (v : m → α) : replicateRow ι (x • v) = x • replicateRow ι v

decls.name: Matrix.transpose_replicateCol
decls.sig: theorem transpose_replicateCol (v : m → α) : (replicateCol ι v)ᵀ = replicateRow ι v

decls.name: Matrix.transpose_replicateRow
decls.sig: theorem transpose_replicateRow (v : m → α) : (replicateRow ι v)ᵀ = replicateCol ι v

decls.name: Matrix.conjTranspose_replicateCol
decls.sig: theorem conjTranspose_replicateCol [Star α] (v : m → α) : (replicateCol ι v)ᴴ = replicateRow ι (star v)

decls.name: Matrix.conjTranspose_replicateRow
decls.sig: theorem conjTranspose_replicateRow [Star α] (v : m → α) : (replicateRow ι v)ᴴ = replicateCol ι (star v)

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow_vecMul
decls.sig: theorem replicateRow_vecMul [Fintype m] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (M : Matrix m n α) (v : m → α) : replicateRow ι (v ᵥ* M) = replicateRow ι v * M
decls.doc: `v ᵥ* M` is the vector whose entries are those of `replicateRow ι v * M`.

decls.name: Matrix.replicateCol_vecMul
decls.sig: theorem replicateCol_vecMul [Fintype m] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (M : Matrix m n α) (v : m → α) : replicateCol ι (v ᵥ* M) = (replicateRow ι v * M)ᵀ

decls.name: Matrix.replicateCol_mulVec
decls.sig: theorem replicateCol_mulVec [Fintype n] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (M : Matrix m n α) (v : n → α) : replicateCol ι (M *ᵥ v) = M * replicateCol ι v
decls.doc: `M *ᵥ v` is the vector whose entries are those of `M * replicateCol ι v`.

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow_mulVec
decls.sig: theorem replicateRow_mulVec [Fintype n] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (M : Matrix m n α) (v : n → α) : replicateRow ι (M *ᵥ v) = (M * replicateCol ι v)ᵀ

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow_mulVec_eq_const
decls.sig: theorem replicateRow_mulVec_eq_const [Fintype m] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (v w : m → α) : replicateRow ι v *ᵥ w = Function.const _ (v ⬝ᵥ w)

decls.name: Matrix.mulVec_replicateCol_eq_const
decls.sig: theorem mulVec_replicateCol_eq_const [Fintype m] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (v w : m → α) : v ᵥ* replicateCol ι w = Function.const _ (v ⬝ᵥ w)

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow_mul_replicateCol
decls.sig: theorem replicateRow_mul_replicateCol [Fintype m] [Mul α] [AddCommMonoid α] (v w : m → α) : replicateRow ι v * replicateCol ι w = of fun _ _ => v ⬝ᵥ w

decls.name: Matrix.replicateRow_mul_replicateCol_apply
decls.sig: theorem replicateRow_mul_replicateCol_apply [Fintype m] [Mul α] [AddCommMonoid α] (v w : m → α) (i j) : (replicateRow ι v * replicateCol ι w) i j = v ⬝ᵥ w

decls.name: Matrix.diag_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow
decls.sig: theorem diag_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow [Mul α] [AddCommMonoid α] [Unique ι] (a b : n → α) : diag (replicateCol ι a * replicateRow ι b) = a * b

decls.name: Matrix.vecMulVec_eq
decls.sig: theorem vecMulVec_eq [Mul α] [AddCommMonoid α] [Unique ι] (w : m → α) (v : n → α) : vecMulVec w v = replicateCol ι w * replicateRow ι v

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow
decls.sig: def updateRow [DecidableEq m] (M : Matrix m n α) (i : m) (b : n → α) : Matrix m n α
decls.doc: Update, i.e. replace the `i`th row of matrix `A` with the values in `b`.

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol
decls.sig: def updateCol [DecidableEq n] (M : Matrix m n α) (j : n) (b : m → α) : Matrix m n α
decls.doc: Update, i.e. replace the `j`th column of matrix `A` with the values in `b`.

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_self
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_self [DecidableEq m] : updateRow M i b i = b

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol_self
decls.sig: theorem updateCol_self [DecidableEq n] : updateCol M j c i j = c i

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_ne
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_ne [DecidableEq m] {i' : m} (i_ne : i' ≠ i) : updateRow M i b i' = M i'

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol_ne
decls.sig: theorem updateCol_ne [DecidableEq n] {j' : n} (j_ne : j' ≠ j) : updateCol M j c i j' = M i j'

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_apply
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_apply [DecidableEq m] {i' : m} : updateRow M i b i' j = if i' = i then b j else M i' j

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol_apply
decls.sig: theorem updateCol_apply [DecidableEq n] {j' : n} : updateCol M j c i j' = if j' = j then c i else M i j'

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol_subsingleton
decls.sig: theorem updateCol_subsingleton [Subsingleton n] (A : Matrix m n R) (i : n) (b : m → R) : A.updateCol i b = (replicateCol (Fin 1) b).submatrix id (Function.const n 0)

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_subsingleton
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_subsingleton [Subsingleton m] (A : Matrix m n R) (i : m) (b : n → R) : A.updateRow i b = (replicateRow (Fin 1) b).submatrix (Function.const m 0) id

decls.name: Matrix.map_updateRow
decls.sig: theorem map_updateRow [DecidableEq m] (f : α → β) : map (updateRow M i b) f = updateRow (M.map f) i (f ∘ b)

decls.name: Matrix.map_updateCol
decls.sig: theorem map_updateCol [DecidableEq n] (f : α → β) : map (updateCol M j c) f = updateCol (M.map f) j (f ∘ c)

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_transpose
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_transpose [DecidableEq n] : updateRow Mᵀ j c = (updateCol M j c)ᵀ

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol_transpose
decls.sig: theorem updateCol_transpose [DecidableEq m] : updateCol Mᵀ i b = (updateRow M i b)ᵀ

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_conjTranspose
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_conjTranspose [DecidableEq n] [Star α] : updateRow Mᴴ j (star c) = (updateCol M j c)ᴴ

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol_conjTranspose
decls.sig: theorem updateCol_conjTranspose [DecidableEq m] [Star α] : updateCol Mᴴ i (star b) = (updateRow M i b)ᴴ

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_eq_self
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_eq_self [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n α) (i : m) : A.updateRow i (A i) = A

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol_eq_self
decls.sig: theorem updateCol_eq_self [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n α) (i : n) : (A.updateCol i fun j => A j i) = A

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_zero_zero
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_zero_zero [DecidableEq m] [Zero α] (i : m) : (0 : Matrix m n α).updateRow i 0 = 0

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol_zero_zero
decls.sig: theorem updateCol_zero_zero [DecidableEq n] [Zero α] (i : n) : (0 : Matrix m n α).updateCol i 0 = 0

decls.name: Matrix.diagonal_updateCol_single
decls.sig: theorem diagonal_updateCol_single [DecidableEq n] [Zero α] (v : n → α) (i : n) (x : α) : (diagonal v).updateCol i (Pi.single i x) = diagonal (Function.update v i x)

decls.name: Matrix.diagonal_updateRow_single
decls.sig: theorem diagonal_updateRow_single [DecidableEq n] [Zero α] (v : n → α) (i : n) (x : α) : (diagonal v).updateRow i (Pi.single i x) = diagonal (Function.update v i x)

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_idem
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_idem [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n α) (i : m) (x y : n → α) : (A.updateRow i x).updateRow i y = A.updateRow i y

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_comm
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_comm [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n α) {i i' : m} (h : i ≠ i') (x y : n → α) : (A.updateRow i x).updateRow i' y = (A.updateRow i' y).updateRow i x

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol_idem
decls.sig: theorem updateCol_idem [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n α) (j : n) (x y : m → α) : (A.updateCol j x).updateCol j y = A.updateCol j y

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol_comm
decls.sig: theorem updateCol_comm [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n α) {j j' : n} (h : j ≠ j') (x y : m → α) : (A.updateCol j x).updateCol j' y = (A.updateCol j' y).updateCol j x

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_submatrix_equiv
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_submatrix_equiv [DecidableEq l] [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n α) (i : l) (r : o → α) (e : l ≃ m) (f : o ≃ n) : updateRow (A.submatrix e f) i r = (A.updateRow (e i) fun j => r (f.symm j)).submatrix e f

decls.name: Matrix.submatrix_updateRow_equiv
decls.sig: theorem submatrix_updateRow_equiv [DecidableEq l] [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n α) (i : m) (r : n → α) (e : l ≃ m) (f : o ≃ n) : (A.updateRow i r).submatrix e f = updateRow (A.submatrix e f) (e.symm i) fun i => r (f i)

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol_submatrix_equiv
decls.sig: theorem updateCol_submatrix_equiv [DecidableEq o] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n α) (j : o) (c : l → α) (e : l ≃ m) (f : o ≃ n) : updateCol (A.submatrix e f) j c = (A.updateCol (f j) fun i => c (e.symm i)).submatrix e f

decls.name: Matrix.submatrix_updateCol_equiv
decls.sig: theorem submatrix_updateCol_equiv [DecidableEq o] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n α) (j : n) (c : m → α) (e : l ≃ m) (f : o ≃ n) : (A.updateCol j c).submatrix e f = updateCol (A.submatrix e f) (f.symm j) fun i => c (e i)

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_reindex
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_reindex [DecidableEq l] [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n α) (i : l) (r : o → α) (e : m ≃ l) (f : n ≃ o) : updateRow (reindex e f A) i r = reindex e f (A.updateRow (e.symm i) fun j => r (f j))

decls.name: Matrix.reindex_updateRow
decls.sig: theorem reindex_updateRow [DecidableEq l] [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n α) (i : m) (r : n → α) (e : m ≃ l) (f : n ≃ o) : reindex e f (A.updateRow i r) = updateRow (reindex e f A) (e i) fun i => r (f.symm i)

decls.name: Matrix.updateCol_reindex
decls.sig: theorem updateCol_reindex [DecidableEq o] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n α) (j : o) (c : l → α) (e : m ≃ l) (f : n ≃ o) : updateCol (reindex e f A) j c = reindex e f (A.updateCol (f.symm j) fun i => c (e i))

decls.name: Matrix.reindex_updateCol
decls.sig: theorem reindex_updateCol [DecidableEq o] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n α) (j : n) (c : m → α) (e : m ≃ l) (f : n ≃ o) : reindex e f (A.updateCol j c) = updateCol (reindex e f A) (f j) fun i => c (e.symm i)

decls.name: Matrix.single_eq_updateRow_zero
decls.sig: theorem single_eq_updateRow_zero [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Zero α] (i : m) (j : n) (r : α) : single i j r = updateRow 0 i (Pi.single j r)

decls.name: Matrix.single_eq_updateCol_zero
decls.sig: theorem single_eq_updateCol_zero [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Zero α] (i : m) (j : n) (r : α) : single i j r = updateCol 0 j (Pi.single i r)

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_mulVec
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_mulVec [DecidableEq l] [Fintype m] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (A : Matrix l m α) (i : l) (c : m → α) (v : m → α) : A.updateRow i c *ᵥ v = Function.update (A *ᵥ v) i (c ⬝ᵥ v)

decls.name: Matrix.vecMul_updateCol
decls.sig: theorem vecMul_updateCol [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (v : m → α) (B : Matrix m n α) (j : n) (r : m → α) : v ᵥ* B.updateCol j r = Function.update (v ᵥ* B) j (v ⬝ᵥ r)

decls.name: Matrix.update_vecMulVec
decls.sig: theorem update_vecMulVec [DecidableEq m] [Mul α] (u : m → α) (v : n → α) (i : m) (a : α) : vecMulVec (Function.update u i a) v = (vecMulVec u v).updateRow i (a • v)

decls.name: Matrix.vecMulVec_update
decls.sig: theorem vecMulVec_update [DecidableEq n] [Mul α] (u : m → α) (v : n → α) (j : n) (a : α) : vecMulVec u (Function.update v j a) = (vecMulVec u v).updateCol j (MulOpposite.op a • u)

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_mul
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_mul [DecidableEq l] [Fintype m] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (A : Matrix l m α) (i : l) (r : m → α) (B : Matrix m n α) : A.updateRow i r * B = (A * B).updateRow i (r ᵥ* B)

decls.name: Matrix.mul_updateCol
decls.sig: theorem mul_updateCol [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (A : Matrix l m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (j : n) (c : m → α) : A * B.updateCol j c = (A * B).updateCol j (A *ᵥ c)

decls.name: Matrix.mul_single_eq_updateCol_zero
decls.sig: theorem mul_single_eq_updateCol_zero [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (A : Matrix l m α) (i : m) (j : n) (r : α) : A * single i j r = updateCol 0 j (A.col i <• r)

decls.name: Matrix.single_mul_eq_updateRow_zero
decls.sig: theorem single_mul_eq_updateRow_zero [DecidableEq l] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype m] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (i : l) (j : m) (r : α) (B : Matrix m n α) : single i j r * B = updateRow 0 i (r • B.row j)

decls.name: Matrix.updateRow_zero_mul_updateCol_zero
decls.sig: theorem updateRow_zero_mul_updateCol_zero [DecidableEq l] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] (i : l) (r : m → α) (j : n) (c : m → α) : (0 : Matrix l m α).updateRow i r * (0 : Matrix m n α).updateCol j c = single i j (r ⬝ᵥ c)

decls.name: Matrix.fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible₁₁
decls.sig: theorem fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible₁₁ (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix l m α) (D : Matrix l n α) [Invertible A] : fromBlocks A B C D = fromBlocks 1 0 (C * ⅟A) 1 * fromBlocks A 0 0 (D - C * ⅟A * B) * fromBlocks 1 (⅟A * B) 0 1
decls.doc: LDU decomposition of a block matrix with an invertible top-left corner, using the Schur complement.

decls.name: Matrix.fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible₂₂
decls.sig: theorem fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible₂₂ (A : Matrix l m α) (B : Matrix l n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible D] : fromBlocks A B C D = fromBlocks 1 (B * ⅟D) 0 1 * fromBlocks (A - B * ⅟D * C) 0 0 D * fromBlocks 1 0 (⅟D * C) 1
decls.doc: LDU decomposition of a block matrix with an invertible bottom-right corner, using the Schur complement.

decls.name: Matrix.fromBlocksZero₂₁Invertible
decls.sig: def fromBlocksZero₂₁Invertible (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible A] [Invertible D] : Invertible (fromBlocks A B 0 D)
decls.doc: An upper-block-triangular matrix is invertible if its diagonal is.

decls.name: Matrix.fromBlocksZero₁₂Invertible
decls.sig: def fromBlocksZero₁₂Invertible (A : Matrix m m α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible A] [Invertible D] : Invertible (fromBlocks A 0 C D)
decls.doc: A lower-block-triangular matrix is invertible if its diagonal is.

decls.name: Matrix.invOf_fromBlocks_zero₂₁_eq
decls.sig: theorem invOf_fromBlocks_zero₂₁_eq (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible A] [Invertible D] [Invertible (fromBlocks A B 0 D)] : ⅟(fromBlocks A B 0 D) = fromBlocks (⅟A) (-(⅟A * B * ⅟D)) 0 (⅟D)

decls.name: Matrix.invOf_fromBlocks_zero₁₂_eq
decls.sig: theorem invOf_fromBlocks_zero₁₂_eq (A : Matrix m m α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible A] [Invertible D] [Invertible (fromBlocks A 0 C D)] : ⅟(fromBlocks A 0 C D) = fromBlocks (⅟A) 0 (-(⅟D * C * ⅟A)) (⅟D)

decls.name: Matrix.invertibleOfFromBlocksZero₂₁Invertible
decls.sig: def invertibleOfFromBlocksZero₂₁Invertible (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible (fromBlocks A B 0 D)] : Invertible A × Invertible D where
decls.doc: Both diagonal entries of an invertible upper-block-triangular matrix are invertible (by reading off the diagonal entries of the inverse).

decls.name: Matrix.invertibleOfFromBlocksZero₁₂Invertible
decls.sig: def invertibleOfFromBlocksZero₁₂Invertible (A : Matrix m m α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible (fromBlocks A 0 C D)] : Invertible A × Invertible D where
decls.doc: Both diagonal entries of an invertible lower-block-triangular matrix are invertible (by reading off the diagonal entries of the inverse).

decls.name: Matrix.fromBlocksZero₂₁InvertibleEquiv
decls.sig: def fromBlocksZero₂₁InvertibleEquiv (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (D : Matrix n n α) : Invertible (fromBlocks A B 0 D) ≃ Invertible A × Invertible D where
decls.doc: `invertibleOfFromBlocksZero₂₁Invertible` and `Matrix.fromBlocksZero₂₁Invertible` form an equivalence.

decls.name: Matrix.fromBlocksZero₁₂InvertibleEquiv
decls.sig: def fromBlocksZero₁₂InvertibleEquiv (A : Matrix m m α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) : Invertible (fromBlocks A 0 C D) ≃ Invertible A × Invertible D where
decls.doc: `invertibleOfFromBlocksZero₁₂Invertible` and `Matrix.fromBlocksZero₁₂Invertible` form an equivalence.

decls.name: Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁
decls.sig: theorem isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁ {A : Matrix m m α} {B : Matrix m n α} {D : Matrix n n α} : IsUnit (fromBlocks A B 0 D) ↔ IsUnit A ∧ IsUnit D
decls.doc: An upper block-triangular matrix is invertible iff both elements of its diagonal are. This is a propositional form of `Matrix.fromBlocksZero₂₁InvertibleEquiv`.

decls.name: Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₁₂
decls.sig: theorem isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₁₂ {A : Matrix m m α} {C : Matrix n m α} {D : Matrix n n α} : IsUnit (fromBlocks A 0 C D) ↔ IsUnit A ∧ IsUnit D
decls.doc: A lower block-triangular matrix is invertible iff both elements of its diagonal are. This is a propositional form of `Matrix.fromBlocksZero₁₂InvertibleEquiv` forms an `iff`.

decls.name: Matrix.inv_fromBlocks_zero₂₁_of_isUnit_iff
decls.sig: theorem inv_fromBlocks_zero₂₁_of_isUnit_iff (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (D : Matrix n n α) (hAD : IsUnit A ↔ IsUnit D) : (fromBlocks A B 0 D)⁻¹ = fromBlocks A⁻¹ (-(A⁻¹ * B * D⁻¹)) 0 D⁻¹
decls.doc: An expression for the inverse of an upper block-triangular matrix, when either both elements of diagonal are invertible, or both are not.

decls.name: Matrix.inv_fromBlocks_zero₁₂_of_isUnit_iff
decls.sig: theorem inv_fromBlocks_zero₁₂_of_isUnit_iff (A : Matrix m m α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) (hAD : IsUnit A ↔ IsUnit D) : (fromBlocks A 0 C D)⁻¹ = fromBlocks A⁻¹ 0 (-(D⁻¹ * C * A⁻¹)) D⁻¹
decls.doc: An expression for the inverse of a lower block-triangular matrix, when either both elements of diagonal are invertible, or both are not.

decls.name: Matrix.fromBlocks₂₂Invertible
decls.sig: def fromBlocks₂₂Invertible (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible D] [Invertible (A - B * ⅟D * C)] : Invertible (fromBlocks A B C D)
decls.doc: A block matrix is invertible if the bottom right corner and the corresponding Schur complement is.

decls.name: Matrix.fromBlocks₁₁Invertible
decls.sig: def fromBlocks₁₁Invertible (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible A] [Invertible (D - C * ⅟A * B)] : Invertible (fromBlocks A B C D)
decls.doc: A block matrix is invertible if the top left corner and the corresponding Schur complement is.

decls.name: Matrix.invOf_fromBlocks₂₂_eq
decls.sig: theorem invOf_fromBlocks₂₂_eq (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible D] [Invertible (A - B * ⅟D * C)] [Invertible (fromBlocks A B C D)] : ⅟(fromBlocks A B C D) = fromBlocks (⅟(A - B * ⅟D * C)) (-(⅟(A - B * ⅟D * C) * B * ⅟D)) (-(⅟D * C * ⅟(A - B * ⅟D * C))) (⅟D + ⅟D * C * ⅟(A - B * ⅟D * C) * B * ⅟D)

decls.name: Matrix.invOf_fromBlocks₁₁_eq
decls.sig: theorem invOf_fromBlocks₁₁_eq (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible A] [Invertible (D - C * ⅟A * B)] [Invertible (fromBlocks A B C D)] : ⅟(fromBlocks A B C D) = fromBlocks (⅟A + ⅟A * B * ⅟(D - C * ⅟A * B) * C * ⅟A) (-(⅟A * B * ⅟(D - C * ⅟A * B))) (-(⅟(D - C * ⅟A * B) * C * ⅟A)) (⅟(D - C * ⅟A * B))

decls.name: Matrix.invertibleOfFromBlocks₂₂Invertible
decls.sig: def invertibleOfFromBlocks₂₂Invertible (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible D] [Invertible (fromBlocks A B C D)] : Invertible (A - B * ⅟D * C)
decls.doc: If a block matrix is invertible and so is its bottom left element, then so is the corresponding Schur complement.

decls.name: Matrix.invertibleOfFromBlocks₁₁Invertible
decls.sig: def invertibleOfFromBlocks₁₁Invertible (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible A] [Invertible (fromBlocks A B C D)] : Invertible (D - C * ⅟A * B)
decls.doc: If a block matrix is invertible and so is its bottom left element, then so is the corresponding Schur complement.

decls.name: Matrix.invertibleEquivFromBlocks₂₂Invertible
decls.sig: def invertibleEquivFromBlocks₂₂Invertible (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible D] : Invertible (fromBlocks A B C D) ≃ Invertible (A - B * ⅟D * C) where
decls.doc: `Matrix.invertibleOfFromBlocks₂₂Invertible` and `Matrix.fromBlocks₂₂Invertible` as an equivalence.

decls.name: Matrix.invertibleEquivFromBlocks₁₁Invertible
decls.sig: def invertibleEquivFromBlocks₁₁Invertible (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible A] : Invertible (fromBlocks A B C D) ≃ Invertible (D - C * ⅟A * B) where
decls.doc: `Matrix.invertibleOfFromBlocks₁₁Invertible` and `Matrix.fromBlocks₁₁Invertible` as an equivalence.

decls.name: Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_iff_of_invertible₂₂
decls.sig: theorem isUnit_fromBlocks_iff_of_invertible₂₂ {A : Matrix m m α} {B : Matrix m n α} {C : Matrix n m α} {D : Matrix n n α} [Invertible D] : IsUnit (fromBlocks A B C D) ↔ IsUnit (A - B * ⅟D * C)
decls.doc: If the bottom-left element of a block matrix is invertible, then the whole matrix is invertible iff the corresponding Schur complement is.

decls.name: Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_iff_of_invertible₁₁
decls.sig: theorem isUnit_fromBlocks_iff_of_invertible₁₁ {A : Matrix m m α} {B : Matrix m n α} {C : Matrix n m α} {D : Matrix n n α} [Invertible A] : IsUnit (fromBlocks A B C D) ↔ IsUnit (D - C * ⅟A * B)
decls.doc: If the top-right element of a block matrix is invertible, then the whole matrix is invertible iff the corresponding Schur complement is.

decls.name: Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁
decls.sig: theorem det_fromBlocks₁₁ (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible A] : (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D).det = det A * det (D - C * ⅟A * B)
decls.doc: Determinant of a 2×2 block matrix, expanded around an invertible top left element in terms of the Schur complement.

decls.name: Matrix.det_fromBlocks_one₁₁
decls.sig: theorem det_fromBlocks_one₁₁ (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) : (Matrix.fromBlocks 1 B C D).det = det (D - C * B)

decls.name: Matrix.det_fromBlocks₂₂
decls.sig: theorem det_fromBlocks₂₂ (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible D] : (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D).det = det D * det (A - B * ⅟D * C)

decls.name: Matrix.det_fromBlocks_one₂₂

decls.name: Matrix.det_one_add_mul_comm
decls.sig: theorem det_one_add_mul_comm (A : Matrix m n α) (B : Matrix n m α) : det (1 + A * B) = det (1 + B * A)
decls.doc: The **Weinstein–Aronszajn identity**. Note the `1` on the LHS is of shape m×m, while the `1` on the RHS is of shape n×n.

decls.name: Matrix.det_mul_add_one_comm

decls.name: Matrix.det_one_sub_mul_comm

decls.name: Matrix.det_one_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow

decls.doc: A special case of the **Matrix determinant lemma** for when `A = I`.

decls.name: Matrix.det_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow
decls.sig: theorem det_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow {ι : Type*} [Unique ι] {A : Matrix m m α} (hA : IsUnit A.det) (u v : m → α) : (A + replicateCol ι u * replicateRow ι v).det = A.det * (1 + replicateRow ι v * A⁻¹ * replicateCol ι u).det
decls.doc: The **Matrix determinant lemma** TODO: show the more general version without `hA : IsUnit A.det` as `(A + replicateCol u * replicateRow v).det = A.det + v ⬝ᵥ (adjugate A) *ᵥ u`.

decls.name: Matrix.det_add_mul

decls.name: Matrix.IsDetpBalanced

decls.doc: A square matrix `A` over a commutative semiring `R` is "determinant balanced" with respect to `a b : R` if `a|A|⁺ + b|A|⁻ = b|A|⁺ + a|A|⁻`. Over a commutative ring, this is equivalent to `(a - b)|A| = 0`, see `Matrix.isDetpBalanced_iff_sub_mul_det_eq_zero`.

decls.name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_coe
decls.sig: lemma transvection_coe {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (b : F) : (transvection hij b) = (1 : Matrix ι ι F) + single i j b

decls.doc: The transvection `transvection i j hij b` acts on `e_i = Pi.single i 1` as the identity.

decls.name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_mulVec_single_self
decls.sig: lemma transvection_mulVec_single_self {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (b : F) : (transvection hij b).1 *ᵥ (Pi.single i (1 : F)) = Pi.single i 1

decls.name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_smul_single_snd
decls.sig: lemma transvection_smul_single_snd {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (b : F) : (transvection hij b) • (Pi.single j 1 : ι → F) = Pi.single j 1 + b • Pi.single i 1
decls.doc: The transvection `transvection i j hij b` acts on `e_j = Pi.single j 1` by adding `b·e_i`.

decls.name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_mulVec_single_other
decls.sig: lemma transvection_mulVec_single_other {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (b : F) : (transvection hij b).1 *ᵥ (Pi.single j (1 : F)) = Pi.single j 1 + b • Pi.single i 1

decls.name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_mul_neg
decls.sig: lemma transvection_mul_neg {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (b : F) : transvection hij b * transvection hij (-b) = 1
decls.doc: Inverse of a transvection: `transvection i j hij b * transvection i j hij (-b) = 1`.

decls.name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_inv
decls.sig: lemma transvection_inv {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (b : F) : (transvection hij b)⁻¹ = transvection hij (-b)

decls.name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.diag2n
decls.sig: noncomputable def diag2n {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : F) (ha : a ≠ 0) : SpecialLinearGroup ι F
decls.doc: An element in SLₙ(F) induced by a diagonal matrix `1` on any other entries and `a`, `a⁻¹` on positition `i` and `j` respectively where `i ≠ j`.

decls.name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.diag2n_coe

decls.doc: Any permutation matrix is row stochastic.

decls.name: Matrix.colStochastic
decls.sig: def colStochastic (R n : Type*) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] : Submonoid (Matrix n n R) where
decls.doc: A square matrix is column stochastic iff all entries are nonnegative, and left multiplication by the vector of all 1s gives the vector of all 1s.

decls.name: Matrix.mem_colStochastic
decls.sig: lemma mem_colStochastic : M ∈ colStochastic R n ↔ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ M i j) ∧ 1 ᵥ* M = 1

decls.name: Matrix.mem_colStochastic_iff_sum
decls.sig: lemma mem_colStochastic_iff_sum : M ∈ colStochastic R n ↔ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ M i j) ∧ (∀ j, ∑ i, M i j = 1)
decls.doc: A matrix is column stochastic if each column sums to one.

decls.name: Matrix.nonneg_of_mem_colStochastic
decls.sig: lemma nonneg_of_mem_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n) {i j : n} : 0 ≤ M i j
decls.doc: Every entry of a column stochastic matrix is nonnegative.

decls.name: Matrix.sum_col_of_mem_colStochastic
decls.sig: lemma sum_col_of_mem_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n) (i : n) : ∑ j, M j i = 1
decls.doc: Each column sum of a column stochastic matrix is 1.

decls.name: Matrix.one_vecMul_of_mem_colStochastic
decls.sig: lemma one_vecMul_of_mem_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n) : 1 ᵥ* M = 1
decls.doc: The all-ones column vector multiplied with a column stochastic matrix is 1.

decls.name: Matrix.le_one_of_mem_colStochastic
decls.sig: lemma le_one_of_mem_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n) {i j : n} : M j i ≤ 1
decls.doc: Every entry of a column stochastic matrix is less than or equal to 1.

decls.name: Matrix.nonneg_mulVec_of_mem_colStochastic
decls.sig: lemma nonneg_mulVec_of_mem_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n) (hx : ∀ i : n, 0 ≤ x i) : ∀ j : n, 0 ≤ (M *ᵥ x) j
decls.doc: Right multiplication of a column stochastic matrix by a non-negative vector gives a non-negative vector.

decls.name: Matrix.nonneg_vecMul_of_mem_colStochastic
decls.sig: lemma nonneg_vecMul_of_mem_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n) (hx : ∀ i : n, 0 ≤ x i) : ∀ j : n, 0 ≤ (x ᵥ* M) j
decls.doc: Left multiplication of a column stochastic matrix by a non-negative vector gives a non-negative vector.

decls.name: Matrix.mulVec_dotProduct_one_eq_one_colStochastic
decls.sig: lemma mulVec_dotProduct_one_eq_one_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n) (hx : 1 ⬝ᵥ x = 1) : 1 ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) = 1
decls.doc: Left left-multiplication by column stochastic preserves `ℓ₁ norm`

decls.name: Matrix.sum_mulVec_of_mem_colStochastic
decls.sig: lemma sum_mulVec_of_mem_colStochastic {M : Matrix n n R} {x : n → R} (hA : M ∈ colStochastic R n) : ∑ i, (M *ᵥ x) i = ∑ i, x i
decls.doc: Applying a column-stochastic matrix to a vector preserves its sum.

decls.name: Matrix.convex_colStochastic
decls.sig: lemma convex_colStochastic : Convex R (colStochastic R n : Set (Matrix n n R))
decls.doc: The set of column stochastic matrices is convex.

decls.name: Matrix.permMatrix_mem_colStochastic
decls.sig: lemma permMatrix_mem_colStochastic {σ : Equiv.Perm n} : σ.permMatrix R ∈ colStochastic R n
decls.doc: Any permutation matrix is column stochastic.

decls.name: Matrix.transpose_mem_rowStochastic_iff_mem_colStochastic
decls.sig: lemma transpose_mem_rowStochastic_iff_mem_colStochastic : Mᵀ ∈ rowStochastic R n ↔ M ∈ colStochastic R n
decls.doc: The transpose of a matrix is row stochastic matrix if it is column stochastic.

decls.name: Matrix.transpose_mem_colStochastic_iff_mem_rowStochastic
decls.sig: lemma transpose_mem_colStochastic_iff_mem_rowStochastic : Mᵀ ∈ colStochastic R n ↔ M ∈ rowStochastic R n
decls.doc: The transpose of a matrix is column stochastic matrix if it is row stochastic.

decls.name: Matrix.reindex_mem_rowStochastic
decls.sig: lemma reindex_mem_rowStochastic {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] {M : Matrix n n R} {e₁ e₂ : n ≃ m} (hM : M ∈ rowStochastic R n) : M.reindex e₁ e₂ ∈ rowStochastic R m
decls.doc: Reindexing a matrix preserves row-stochasticity.

decls.name: Matrix.reindex_mem_rowStochastic_iff
decls.sig: lemma reindex_mem_rowStochastic_iff {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] {M : Matrix n n R} {e₁ e₂ : n ≃ m} : M.reindex e₁ e₂ ∈ rowStochastic R m ↔ M ∈ rowStochastic R n
decls.doc: Reindexing a matrix preserves row-stochasticity.

decls.name: Matrix.reindex_mem_colStochastic_iff
decls.sig: lemma reindex_mem_colStochastic_iff {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] {M : Matrix n n R} {e₁ e₂ : n ≃ m} : M.reindex e₁ e₂ ∈ colStochastic R m ↔ M ∈ colStochastic R n
decls.doc: Reindexing a matrix preserves column-stochasticity.

decls.name: Matrix.swap
decls.sig: def swap (i j : n) : Matrix n n R
decls.doc: The swap matrix `swap R i j` is the identity matrix with the `i`-th and `j`-th rows modified such that multiplying by it on the left (resp. right) corresponds to swapping the `i`-th and `j`-th row (resp. column).

decls.name: Matrix.swap_comm
decls.sig: lemma swap_comm (i j : n) : swap R i j = swap R j i

decls.name: Matrix.transpose_swap
decls.sig: lemma transpose_swap (i j : n) : (swap R i j).transpose = swap R i j

decls.name: Matrix.isSymm_swap
decls.sig: theorem isSymm_swap (i j : n) : (swap R i j).IsSymm

decls.name: Matrix.conjTranspose_swap
decls.sig: lemma conjTranspose_swap {R : Type*} [NonAssocSemiring R] [StarRing R] (i j : n) : (swap R i j).conjTranspose = swap R i j

decls.name: Matrix.map_swap
decls.sig: lemma map_swap {S : Type*} [NonAssocSemiring S] (f : R →+* S) (i j : n) : (swap R i j).map f = swap S i j

decls.name: Matrix.swap_mulVec
decls.sig: lemma swap_mulVec (i j : n) (a : n → R) : swap R i j *ᵥ a = a ∘ Equiv.swap i j

decls.name: Matrix.vecMul_swap
decls.sig: lemma vecMul_swap (i j : n) (a : n → R) : a ᵥ* swap R i j = a ∘ Equiv.swap i j

decls.name: Matrix.swap_mulVec_apply
decls.sig: lemma swap_mulVec_apply (i j : n) (a : n → R) : (swap R i j *ᵥ a) i = a j

decls.name: Matrix.vecMul_swap_apply
decls.sig: lemma vecMul_swap_apply (i j : n) (a : n → R) : (a ᵥ* swap R i j) i = a j

decls.name: Matrix.swap_mul_apply_left
decls.sig: lemma swap_mul_apply_left (i j : n) (a : m) (g : Matrix n m R) : (swap R i j * g) i a = g j a
decls.doc: Multiplying with `swap R i j` on the left swaps the `i`-th row with the `j`-th row.

decls.name: Matrix.swap_mul_apply_right
decls.sig: lemma swap_mul_apply_right (i j : n) (a : m) (g : Matrix n m R) : (swap R i j * g) j a = g i a
decls.doc: Multiplying with `swap R i j` on the left swaps the `j`-th row with the `i`-th row.

decls.name: Matrix.swap_mul_of_ne
decls.sig: lemma swap_mul_of_ne {i j a : n} {b : m} (hai : a ≠ i) (haj : a ≠ j) (g : Matrix n m R) : (swap R i j * g) a b = g a b

decls.name: Matrix.mul_swap_apply_left
decls.sig: lemma mul_swap_apply_left (i j : n) (a : m) (g : Matrix m n R) : (g * swap R i j) a i = g a j
decls.doc: Multiplying with `swap R i j` on the right swaps the `i`-th column with the `j`-th column.

decls.name: Matrix.mul_swap_apply_right
decls.sig: lemma mul_swap_apply_right (i j : n) (a : m) (g : Matrix m n R) : (g * swap R i j) a j = g a i
decls.doc: Multiplying with `swap R i j` on the right swaps the `j`-th column with the `i`-th column.

decls.name: Matrix.mul_swap_of_ne
decls.sig: lemma mul_swap_of_ne {i j b : n} {a : m} (hbi : b ≠ i) (hbj : b ≠ j) (g : Matrix m n R) : (g * swap R i j) a b = g a b

decls.name: Matrix.swap_mul_self
decls.sig: lemma swap_mul_self (i j : n) : swap R i j * swap R i j = 1
decls.doc: Swap matrices are self inverse.

decls.name: Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.swap
decls.sig: def swap (i j : n) : GL n R where
decls.doc: `Matrix.swap` as an element of `GL n R`.

decls.name: Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map_swap
decls.sig: lemma map_swap (i j : n) : (swap R i j).map f = swap S i j

decls.sig: theorem IsSymm.transpose {A : Matrix n n α} (h : A.IsSymm) : Aᵀ.IsSymm

decls.sig: theorem IsSymm.conjTranspose [Star α] {A : Matrix n n α} (h : A.IsSymm) : Aᴴ.IsSymm

decls.name: Matrix.IsSymm.add
decls.sig: theorem IsSymm.add {A B : Matrix n n α} [Add α] (hA : A.IsSymm) (hB : B.IsSymm) : (A + B).IsSymm

decls.sig: theorem IsSymm.sub {A B : Matrix n n α} [Sub α] (hA : A.IsSymm) (hB : B.IsSymm) : (A - B).IsSymm

decls.sig: theorem IsSymm.smul [SMul R α] {A : Matrix n n α} (h : A.IsSymm) (k : R) : (k • A).IsSymm

decls.name: Matrix.IsSymm.dotProduct_mulVec_comm
decls.sig: lemma IsSymm.dotProduct_mulVec_comm [Fintype n] [NonUnitalCommSemiring α] {A : Matrix n n α} (hA : A.IsSymm) {x y : n → α} : x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ y = y ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ x

decls.sig: theorem IsSymm.submatrix {A : Matrix n n α} (h : A.IsSymm) (f : m → n) : (A.submatrix f f).IsSymm

decls.doc: This is the `iff` version of `Matrix.isSymm.fromBlocks`.

decls.name: Matrix.isSymm_comp_iff
decls.sig: theorem isSymm_comp_iff {A : Matrix m m (Matrix n n α)} : (A.comp m m n n α).IsSymm ↔ Aᵀ = A.map (·ᵀ)

decls.name: Matrix.isSymm_comp_iff_forall

decls.sig: theorem Matrix.mulVecBilin_apply [Fintype n] (M : Matrix m n A) (v : n → A) : Matrix.mulVecBilin R S M v = M *ᵥ v

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix
decls.sig: def charmatrix (M : Matrix n n R) : Matrix n n R[X]
decls.doc: The "characteristic matrix" of `M : Matrix n n R` is the matrix of polynomials $t I - M$. The determinant of this matrix is the characteristic polynomial.

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_apply
decls.sig: theorem charmatrix_apply : charmatrix M i j = (Matrix.diagonal fun _ : n => X) i j - C (M i j)

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq
decls.sig: theorem charmatrix_apply_eq : charmatrix M i i = (X : R[X]) - C (M i i)

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_apply_ne
decls.sig: theorem charmatrix_apply_ne (h : i ≠ j) : charmatrix M i j = -C (M i j)

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_zero
decls.sig: theorem charmatrix_zero : charmatrix (0 : Matrix n n R) = Matrix.scalar n (X : R[X])

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_diagonal
decls.sig: theorem charmatrix_diagonal (d : n → R) : charmatrix (diagonal d) = diagonal fun i => X - C (d i)

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_one
decls.sig: theorem charmatrix_one : charmatrix (1 : Matrix n n R) = diagonal fun _ => X - 1

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_natCast
decls.sig: theorem charmatrix_natCast (k : ℕ) : charmatrix (k : Matrix n n R) = diagonal fun _ => X - (k : R[X])

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_ofNat
decls.sig: theorem charmatrix_ofNat (k : ℕ) [k.AtLeastTwo] : charmatrix (ofNat(k) : Matrix n n R) = diagonal fun _ => X - ofNat(k)

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_transpose
decls.sig: theorem charmatrix_transpose (M : Matrix n n R) : (Mᵀ).charmatrix = M.charmatrixᵀ

decls.name: Matrix.matPolyEquiv_charmatrix
decls.sig: theorem matPolyEquiv_charmatrix : matPolyEquiv (charmatrix M) = X - C M

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_reindex
decls.sig: theorem charmatrix_reindex (e : n ≃ m) : charmatrix (reindex e e M) = reindex e e (charmatrix M)

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_map
decls.sig: lemma charmatrix_map (M : Matrix n n R) (f : R →+* S) : charmatrix (M.map f) = (charmatrix M).map (Polynomial.map f)

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_mul_map_C_of_mul_eq_mul
decls.sig: lemma charmatrix_mul_map_C_of_mul_eq_mul {A : Matrix n n R} {B : Matrix m m R} {P : Matrix n m R} (h : A * P = P * B) : charmatrix A * P.map C = P.map C * charmatrix B

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_fromBlocks
decls.sig: lemma charmatrix_fromBlocks : charmatrix (fromBlocks M₁₁ M₁₂ M₂₁ M₂₂) = fromBlocks (charmatrix M₁₁) (- M₁₂.map C) (- M₂₁.map C) (charmatrix M₂₂)

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_blockTriangular_iff
decls.sig: lemma charmatrix_blockTriangular_iff {α : Type*} [Preorder α] {M : Matrix n n R} {b : n → α} : M.charmatrix.BlockTriangular b ↔ M.BlockTriangular b

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly
decls.sig: def charpoly (M : Matrix n n R) : R[X]
decls.doc: The characteristic polynomial of a matrix `M` is given by $\det (t I - M)$.

decls.name: Matrix.eval_charpoly
decls.sig: theorem eval_charpoly (M : Matrix m m R) (t : R) : M.charpoly.eval t = (Matrix.scalar _ t - M).det

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_isEmpty
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_isEmpty [IsEmpty n] {A : Matrix n n R} : charpoly A = 1

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_zero
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_zero : charpoly (0 : Matrix n n R) = X ^ Fintype.card n

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_diagonal
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_diagonal (d : n → R) : charpoly (diagonal d) = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_one
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_one : charpoly (1 : Matrix n n R) = (X - 1) ^ Fintype.card n

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_natCast
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_natCast (k : ℕ) : charpoly (k : Matrix n n R) = (X - (k : R[X])) ^ Fintype.card n

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_ofNat
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_ofNat (k : ℕ) [k.AtLeastTwo] : charpoly (ofNat(k) : Matrix n n R) = (X - ofNat(k)) ^ Fintype.card n

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_transpose
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_transpose (M : Matrix n n R) : (Mᵀ).charpoly = M.charpoly

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_reindex
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_reindex (e : n ≃ m) (M : Matrix n n R) : (reindex e e M).charpoly = M.charpoly

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_map
decls.sig: lemma charpoly_map (M : Matrix n n R) (f : R →+* S) : (M.map f).charpoly = M.charpoly.map f

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_fromBlocks_zero₂₁

decls.name: Matrix.BlockTriangular.charpoly
decls.sig: lemma BlockTriangular.charpoly {α : Type*} {b : n → α} [LinearOrder α] (h : M.BlockTriangular b) : M.charpoly = ∏ a ∈ image b univ, (M.toSquareBlock b a).charpoly

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular
decls.sig: lemma charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular [LinearOrder n] (M : Matrix n n R) (h : M.IsUpperTriangular) : M.charpoly = ∏ i : n, (X - C (M i i))

decls.name: Matrix.aeval_self_charpoly
decls.sig: theorem aeval_self_charpoly (M : Matrix n n R) : aeval M M.charpoly = 0
decls.doc: The **Cayley-Hamilton Theorem**, that the characteristic polynomial of a matrix, applied to the matrix itself, is zero. This holds over any commutative ring. See `LinearMap.aeval_self_charpoly` for the equivalent statement about endomorphisms.

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm'
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_mul_comm' (A : Matrix m n R) (B : Matrix n m R) : X ^ Fintype.card n * (A * B).charpoly = X ^ Fintype.card m * (B * A).charpoly
decls.doc: A version of `Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm` for rectangular matrices. See also `Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm_of_le` which has just `(A * B).charpoly` as the LHS.

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm_of_le
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_mul_comm_of_le (A : Matrix m n R) (B : Matrix n m R) (hle : Fintype.card n ≤ Fintype.card m) : (A * B).charpoly = X ^ (Fintype.card m - Fintype.card n) * (B * A).charpoly

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_mul_comm (A B : Matrix n n R) : (A * B).charpoly = (B * A).charpoly
decls.doc: A version of `charpoly_mul_comm'` for square matrices.

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_vecMulVec
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_vecMulVec (u v : n → R) : (vecMulVec u v).charpoly = X ^ Fintype.card n - (u ⬝ᵥ v) • X ^ (Fintype.card n - 1)

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_units_conj
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_units_conj (M : (Matrix n n R)ˣ) (N : Matrix n n R) : (M.val * N * M.val⁻¹).charpoly = N.charpoly

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_units_conj'
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_units_conj' (M : (Matrix n n R)ˣ) (N : Matrix n n R) : (M.val⁻¹ * N * M.val).charpoly = N.charpoly

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_eq_of_mul_eq_mul
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_eq_of_mul_eq_mul [IsDomain R] {A B P : Matrix n n R} (hP : P.det ≠ 0) (h : A * P = P * B) : A.charpoly = B.charpoly

decls.name: Algebra.aeval_charpoly_leftMulMatrix
decls.sig: theorem Algebra.aeval_charpoly_leftMulMatrix {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R S) (a : S) : aeval a (leftMulMatrix b a).charpoly = 0

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_apply_natDegree

decls.name: Matrix.charmatrix_apply_natDegree_le
decls.sig: theorem charmatrix_apply_natDegree_le (i j : n) : (charmatrix M i j).natDegree ≤ ite (i = j) 1 0

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_sub_diagonal_degree_lt

decls.sig: theorem charpoly_coeff_eq_prod_coeff_of_le {k : ℕ} (h : Fintype.card n - 1 ≤ k) : M.charpoly.coeff k = (∏ i : n, (X - C (M i i))).coeff k

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_degree_eq_dim

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim

decls.sig: theorem charpoly_monic (M : Matrix n n R) : M.charpoly.Monic

decls.name: Matrix.derivative_det_one_add_X_smul
decls.sig: lemma derivative_det_one_add_X_smul (M : Matrix n n R) : (derivative <| det (1 + (X : R[X]) • M.map C)).eval 0 = trace M
decls.doc: The derivative of `det (1 + M X)` at `0` is the trace of `M`.

decls.name: Matrix.coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_one
decls.sig: lemma coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_one (M : Matrix n n R) : (det (1 + (X : R[X]) • M.map C)).coeff 1 = trace M

decls.name: Matrix.det_one_add_X_smul
decls.sig: lemma det_one_add_X_smul (M : Matrix n n R) : det (1 + (X : R[X]) • M.map C) = (1 : R[X]) + trace M • X + (det (1 + (X : R[X]) • M.map C)).divX.divX * X ^ 2

decls.name: Matrix.det_one_add_smul
decls.sig: lemma det_one_add_smul (r : R) (M : Matrix n n R) : det (1 + r • M) = 1 + trace M * r + (det (1 + (X : R[X]) • M.map C)).divX.divX.eval r * r ^ 2
decls.doc: The first two terms of the Taylor expansion of `det (1 + r • M)` at `r = 0`.

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_of_card_eq_two

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_fin_two
decls.sig: lemma charpoly_fin_two [Nontrivial R] (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) : M.charpoly = X ^ 2 - C M.trace * X + C M.det

decls.name: matPolyEquiv_eq_X_pow_sub_C

decls.name: Matrix.aeval_eq_aeval_mod_charpoly
decls.sig: theorem aeval_eq_aeval_mod_charpoly (M : Matrix n n R) (p : R[X]) : aeval M p = aeval M (p %ₘ M.charpoly)
decls.doc: Any matrix polynomial `p` is equivalent under evaluation to `p %ₘ M.charpoly`; that is, `p` is equivalent to a polynomial with degree less than the dimension of the matrix.

decls.name: Matrix.pow_eq_aeval_mod_charpoly
decls.sig: theorem pow_eq_aeval_mod_charpoly (M : Matrix n n R) (k : ℕ) : M ^ k = aeval M (X ^ k %ₘ M.charpoly)
decls.doc: Any matrix power can be computed as the sum of matrix powers less than `Fintype.card n`. TODO: add the statement for negative powers phrased with `zpow`.

decls.name: Matrix.coeff_charpoly_mem_ideal_pow

decls.name: Matrix.charpolyRev
decls.sig: def charpolyRev (M : Matrix n n R) : R[X]
decls.doc: The reverse of the characteristic polynomial of a matrix. It has some advantages over the characteristic polynomial, including the fact that it can be extended to infinite dimensions (for appropriate operators). In such settings it is known as the "characteristic power series".

decls.name: Matrix.reverse_charpoly
decls.sig: lemma reverse_charpoly (M : Matrix n n R) : M.charpoly.reverse = M.charpolyRev

decls.name: Matrix.det_piecewise_one_eq_submatrix_det
decls.sig: lemma det_piecewise_one_eq_submatrix_det (M : Matrix n n R) (s : Finset n) : det (Matrix.of <| s.piecewise M.row (1 : Matrix n n R).row) = (M.submatrix (↑) (↑) : Matrix s s R).det
decls.doc: The determinant of the matrix obtained by replacing rows outside `s` with identity rows equals the determinant of the principal submatrix indexed by `s`.

decls.name: Matrix.coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_eq_sum_minors
decls.sig: theorem coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_eq_sum_minors (M : Matrix n n R) (k : ℕ) : (det (1 + (X : R[X]) • M.map C)).coeff k = ∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : s → n) (Subtype.val : s → n)).det
decls.doc: The k-th coefficient of `det (1 + X • M)` equals the sum of all k×k principal minors of M. This generalizes `coeff_det_one_add_X_smul_one` (the k = 1 case, which gives the trace) and `det_eq_sign_charpoly_coeff` (the k = n case, which gives the determinant).

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly_coeff_eq_sum_minors
decls.sig: theorem charpoly_coeff_eq_sum_minors (M : Matrix n n R) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) : M.charpoly.coeff (Fintype.card n - k) = (-1) ^ k * ∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.powersetCard k, (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : s → n) (Subtype.val : s → n)).det
decls.doc: The coefficients of the characteristic polynomial are signed sums of principal minors. Specifically, the (n-k)-th coefficient of the characteristic polynomial of M equals `(-1)^k` times the sum of all k×k principal minors of M.

decls.name: Matrix.discr

decls.doc: The discriminant of a matrix is defined to be the discriminant of its characteristic polynomial.

decls.name: Matrix.discr_conj'
