decls.sig: lemma optionEquivLeft_symm_univ_isHomogeneous : ((optionEquivLeft R (n × n)).symm (univ R n)).IsHomogeneous (Fintype.card n)

decls.name: Matrix.charpoly.univ_coeff_isHomogeneous
decls.sig: lemma univ_coeff_isHomogeneous (i j : ℕ) (h : i + j = Fintype.card n) : ((univ R n).coeff i).IsHomogeneous j

decls.name: Matrix.detRowAlternating
decls.sig: def detRowAlternating : (n → R) [⋀^n]→ₗ[R] R
decls.doc: `det` is an `AlternatingMap` in the rows of the matrix.

decls.name: Matrix.det
decls.sig: def det (M : Matrix n n R) : R
decls.doc: The determinant of a matrix given by the Leibniz formula. This is available in bundled forms as: * `Matrix.detMonoidHom` * `Matrix.detRowAlternating`

decls.name: Matrix.det_apply
decls.sig: theorem det_apply (M : Matrix n n R) : M.det = ∑ σ : Perm n, Equiv.Perm.sign σ • ∏ i, M (σ i) i

decls.name: Matrix.det_apply'
decls.sig: theorem det_apply' (M : Matrix n n R) : M.det = ∑ σ : Perm n, ε σ * ∏ i, M (σ i) i

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_detp_sub_detp
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_detp_sub_detp (M : Matrix n n R) : M.det = M.detp 1 - M.detp (-1)

decls.name: Matrix.det_diagonal
decls.sig: theorem det_diagonal {d : n → R} : det (diagonal d) = ∏ i, d i

decls.name: Matrix.det_zero
decls.sig: @[simp] theorem det_zero [Nonempty n] : det (0 : Matrix n n R) = 0

decls.name: Matrix.det_one
decls.sig: theorem det_one : det (1 : Matrix n n R) = 1

decls.name: Matrix.det_isEmpty
decls.sig: theorem det_isEmpty [IsEmpty n] {A : Matrix n n R} : det A = 1

decls.name: Matrix.coe_det_isEmpty
decls.sig: theorem coe_det_isEmpty [IsEmpty n] : (det : Matrix n n R → R) = Function.const _ 1

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_one_of_card_eq_zero
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_one_of_card_eq_zero {A : Matrix n n R} (h : Fintype.card n = 0) : det A = 1

decls.name: Matrix.det_unique
decls.sig: theorem det_unique {n : Type*} [Unique n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix n n R) : det A = A default default
decls.doc: If `n` has only one element, the determinant of an `n` by `n` matrix is just that element. Although `Unique` implies `DecidableEq` and `Fintype`, the instances might not be syntactically equal. Thus, we need to fill in the args explicitly.

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_elem_of_subsingleton
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_elem_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton n] (A : Matrix n n R) (k : n) : det A = A k k

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_elem_of_card_eq_one
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_elem_of_card_eq_one {A : Matrix n n R} (h : Fintype.card n = 1) (k : n) : det A = A k k

decls.name: Matrix.det_mul_aux
decls.sig: theorem det_mul_aux {M N : Matrix n n R} {p : n → n} (H : ¬Bijective p) : (∑ σ : Perm n, ε σ * ∏ x, M (σ x) (p x) * N (p x) x) = 0

decls.name: Matrix.det_mul
decls.sig: theorem det_mul (M N : Matrix n n R) : det (M * N) = det M * det N

decls.name: Matrix.detMonoidHom
decls.sig: def detMonoidHom : Matrix n n R →* R where
decls.doc: The determinant of a matrix, as a monoid homomorphism.

decls.name: Matrix.coe_detMonoidHom
decls.sig: theorem coe_detMonoidHom : (detMonoidHom : Matrix n n R → R) = det

decls.name: Matrix.det_mul_comm
decls.sig: theorem det_mul_comm (M N : Matrix m m R) : det (M * N) = det (N * M)
decls.doc: On square matrices, `mul_comm` applies under `det`.

decls.name: Matrix.det_mul_left_comm
decls.sig: theorem det_mul_left_comm (M N P : Matrix m m R) : det (M * (N * P)) = det (N * (M * P))
decls.doc: On square matrices, `mul_left_comm` applies under `det`.

decls.name: Matrix.det_mul_right_comm
decls.sig: theorem det_mul_right_comm (M N P : Matrix m m R) : det (M * N * P) = det (M * P * N)
decls.doc: On square matrices, `mul_right_comm` applies under `det`.

decls.name: Matrix.det_units_conj
decls.sig: theorem det_units_conj (M : (Matrix m m R)ˣ) (N : Matrix m m R) : det (M.val * N * M⁻¹.val) = det N

decls.name: Matrix.det_units_conj'
decls.sig: theorem det_units_conj' (M : (Matrix m m R)ˣ) (N : Matrix m m R) : det (M⁻¹.val * N * ↑M.val) = det N

decls.name: Matrix.det_transpose
decls.sig: theorem det_transpose (M : Matrix n n R) : Mᵀ.det = M.det
decls.doc: Transposing a matrix preserves the determinant.

decls.name: Matrix.det_permute
decls.sig: theorem det_permute (σ : Perm n) (M : Matrix n n R) : (M.submatrix σ id).det = Perm.sign σ * M.det
decls.doc: Permuting the columns changes the sign of the determinant.

decls.name: Matrix.det_permute'
decls.sig: theorem det_permute' (σ : Perm n) (M : Matrix n n R) : (M.submatrix id σ).det = Perm.sign σ * M.det
decls.doc: Permuting the rows changes the sign of the determinant.

decls.name: Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self
decls.sig: theorem det_submatrix_equiv_self (e : n ≃ m) (A : Matrix m m R) : det (A.submatrix e e) = det A
decls.doc: Permuting rows and columns with the same equivalence does not change the determinant.

decls.name: Matrix.abs_det_submatrix_equiv_equiv
decls.sig: theorem abs_det_submatrix_equiv_equiv {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (e₁ e₂ : n ≃ m) (A : Matrix m m R) : |(A.submatrix e₁ e₂).det| = |A.det|
decls.doc: Permuting rows and columns with two equivalences does not change the absolute value of the determinant.

decls.name: Matrix.det_reindex_self
decls.sig: theorem det_reindex_self (e : m ≃ n) (A : Matrix m m R) : det (reindex e e A) = det A
decls.doc: Reindexing both indices along the same equivalence preserves the determinant. For the `simp` version of this lemma, see `det_submatrix_equiv_self`; this one is unsuitable because `Matrix.reindex_apply` unfolds `reindex` first.

decls.name: Matrix.det_reindex
decls.sig: lemma det_reindex (e e' : m ≃ n) (M : Matrix m m R) : (M.reindex e e').det = sign (e'.trans e.symm) * M.det

decls.name: Matrix.abs_det_reindex
decls.sig: theorem abs_det_reindex {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (e₁ e₂ : m ≃ n) (A : Matrix m m R) : |det (reindex e₁ e₂ A)| = |det A|
decls.doc: Reindexing both indices along equivalences preserves the absolute of the determinant. For the `simp` version of this lemma, see `abs_det_submatrix_equiv_equiv`; this one is unsuitable because `Matrix.reindex_apply` unfolds `reindex` first.

decls.name: Matrix.det_smul
decls.sig: theorem det_smul (A : Matrix n n R) (c : R) : det (c • A) = c ^ Fintype.card n * det A

decls.name: Matrix.det_smul_of_tower
decls.sig: theorem det_smul_of_tower {α} [Monoid α] [MulAction α R] [IsScalarTower α R R] [SMulCommClass α R R] (c : α) (A : Matrix n n R) : det (c • A) = c ^ Fintype.card n • det A

decls.name: Matrix.det_neg
decls.sig: theorem det_neg (A : Matrix n n R) : det (-A) = (-1) ^ Fintype.card n * det A

decls.name: Matrix.det_neg_eq_smul
decls.sig: theorem det_neg_eq_smul (A : Matrix n n R) : det (-A) = (-1 : Units ℤ) ^ Fintype.card n • det A
decls.doc: A variant of `Matrix.det_neg` with scalar multiplication by `Units ℤ` instead of multiplication by `R`.

decls.name: Matrix.det_mul_row
decls.sig: theorem det_mul_row (v : n → R) (A : Matrix n n R) : det (of fun i j => v j * A i j) = (∏ i, v i) * det A
decls.doc: Multiplying each row by a fixed `v i` multiplies the determinant by the product of the `v`s.

decls.name: Matrix.det_mul_column
decls.sig: theorem det_mul_column (v : n → R) (A : Matrix n n R) : det (of fun i j => v i * A i j) = (∏ i, v i) * det A
decls.doc: Multiplying each column by a fixed `v j` multiplies the determinant by the product of the `v`s.

decls.name: Matrix.det_pow
decls.sig: theorem det_pow (M : Matrix m m R) (n : ℕ) : det (M ^ n) = det M ^ n

decls.name: RingHom.map_det
decls.sig: theorem _root_.RingHom.map_det (f : R →+* S) (M : Matrix n n R) : f M.det = Matrix.det (f.mapMatrix M)

decls.name: RingEquiv.map_det
decls.sig: theorem _root_.RingEquiv.map_det (f : R ≃+* S) (M : Matrix n n R) : f M.det = Matrix.det (f.mapMatrix M)

decls.name: AlgHom.map_det
decls.sig: theorem _root_.AlgHom.map_det [Algebra R S] {T : Type z} [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] (f : S →ₐ[R] T) (M : Matrix n n S) : f M.det = Matrix.det (f.mapMatrix M)

decls.name: AlgEquiv.map_det
decls.sig: theorem _root_.AlgEquiv.map_det [Algebra R S] {T : Type z} [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] (f : S ≃ₐ[R] T) (M : Matrix n n S) : f M.det = Matrix.det (f.mapMatrix M)

decls.name: Int.cast_det
decls.sig: theorem _root_.Int.cast_det (M : Matrix n n ℤ) : (M.det : R) = (M.map fun x ↦ (x : R)).det

decls.name: Rat.cast_det
decls.sig: theorem _root_.Rat.cast_det {F : Type*} [Field F] [CharZero F] (M : Matrix n n ℚ) : (M.det : F) = (M.map fun x ↦ (x : F)).det

decls.name: Matrix.det_conjTranspose
decls.sig: theorem det_conjTranspose [StarRing R] (M : Matrix m m R) : det Mᴴ = star (det M)

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero {A : Matrix n n R} (i : n) (h : ∀ j, A i j = 0) : det A = 0

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_column_eq_zero
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_zero_of_column_eq_zero {A : Matrix n n R} (j : n) (h : ∀ i, A i j = 0) : det A = 0

decls.name: Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq
decls.sig: theorem det_zero_of_row_eq (i_ne_j : i ≠ j) (hij : M i = M j) : M.det = 0
decls.doc: If a matrix has a repeated row, the determinant will be zero.

decls.name: Matrix.det_zero_of_column_eq
decls.sig: theorem det_zero_of_column_eq (i_ne_j : i ≠ j) (hij : ∀ k, M k i = M k j) : M.det = 0
decls.doc: If a matrix has a repeated column, the determinant will be zero.

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateRow_eq_zero
decls.sig: theorem det_updateRow_eq_zero (h : i ≠ j) : (M.updateRow j (M i)).det = 0
decls.doc: If we repeat a row of a matrix, we get a matrix of determinant zero.

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateCol_eq_zero
decls.sig: theorem det_updateCol_eq_zero (h : i ≠ j) : (M.updateCol j (fun k ↦ M k i)).det = 0
decls.doc: If we repeat a column of a matrix, we get a matrix of determinant zero.

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateRow_add
decls.sig: theorem det_updateRow_add (M : Matrix n n R) (j : n) (u v : n → R) : det (updateRow M j <| u + v) = det (updateRow M j u) + det (updateRow M j v)

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateCol_add
decls.sig: theorem det_updateCol_add (M : Matrix n n R) (j : n) (u v : n → R) : det (updateCol M j <| u + v) = det (updateCol M j u) + det (updateCol M j v)

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateRow_smul
decls.sig: theorem det_updateRow_smul (M : Matrix n n R) (j : n) (s : R) (u : n → R) : det (updateRow M j <| s • u) = s * det (updateRow M j u)

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateCol_smul
decls.sig: theorem det_updateCol_smul (M : Matrix n n R) (j : n) (s : R) (u : n → R) : det (updateCol M j <| s • u) = s * det (updateCol M j u)

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateRow_smul_left
decls.sig: theorem det_updateRow_smul_left (M : Matrix n n R) (j : n) (s : R) (u : n → R) : det (updateRow (s • M) j u) = s ^ (Fintype.card n - 1) * det (updateRow M j u)

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateCol_smul_left
decls.sig: theorem det_updateCol_smul_left (M : Matrix n n R) (j : n) (s : R) (u : n → R) : det (updateCol (s • M) j u) = s ^ (Fintype.card n - 1) * det (updateCol M j u)

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateRow_sum_aux
decls.sig: theorem det_updateRow_sum_aux (M : Matrix n n R) {j : n} (s : Finset n) (hj : j ∉ s) (c : n → R) (a : R) : (M.updateRow j (a • M j + ∑ k ∈ s, (c k) • M k)).det = a • M.det

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateRow_sum
decls.sig: theorem det_updateRow_sum (A : Matrix n n R) (j : n) (c : n → R) : (A.updateRow j (∑ k, (c k) • A k)).det = (c j) • A.det
decls.doc: If we replace a row of a matrix by a linear combination of its rows, then the determinant is multiplied by the coefficient of that row.

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateCol_sum
decls.sig: theorem det_updateCol_sum (A : Matrix n n R) (j : n) (c : n → R) : (A.updateCol j (fun k ↦ ∑ i, (c i) • A k i)).det = (c j) • A.det
decls.doc: If we replace a column of a matrix by a linear combination of its columns, then the determinant is multiplied by the coefficient of that column.

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_of_eq_mul_det_one
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_of_eq_mul_det_one {A B : Matrix n n R} (C : Matrix n n R) (hC : det C = 1) (hA : A = B * C) : det A = det B

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_of_eq_det_one_mul
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_of_eq_det_one_mul {A B : Matrix n n R} (C : Matrix n n R) (hC : det C = 1) (hA : A = C * B) : det A = det B

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateRow_add_self
decls.sig: theorem det_updateRow_add_self (A : Matrix n n R) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) : det (updateRow A i (A i + A j)) = det A

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateCol_add_self
decls.sig: theorem det_updateCol_add_self (A : Matrix n n R) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) : det (updateCol A i fun k => A k i + A k j) = det A

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateRow_add_smul_self
decls.sig: theorem det_updateRow_add_smul_self (A : Matrix n n R) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (c : R) : det (updateRow A i (A i + c • A j)) = det A

decls.name: Matrix.det_updateCol_add_smul_self
decls.sig: theorem det_updateCol_add_smul_self (A : Matrix n n R) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) (c : R) : det (updateCol A i fun k => A k i + c • A k j) = det A

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent_rows
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent_rows [IsDomain R] {A : Matrix m m R} (hA : ¬ LinearIndependent R (fun i ↦ A i)) : det A = 0

decls.name: Matrix.linearIndependent_rows_of_det_ne_zero
decls.sig: theorem linearIndependent_rows_of_det_ne_zero [IsDomain R] {A : Matrix m m R} (hA : A.det ≠ 0) : LinearIndependent R (fun i ↦ A i)

decls.name: Matrix.linearIndependent_cols_of_det_ne_zero
decls.sig: theorem linearIndependent_cols_of_det_ne_zero [IsDomain R] {A : Matrix m m R} (hA : A.det ≠ 0) : LinearIndependent R A.col

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent_cols
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent_cols [IsDomain R] {A : Matrix m m R} (hA : ¬ LinearIndependent R (fun i ↦ Aᵀ i)) : det A = 0

decls.name: Matrix.det_vecMulVec
decls.sig: theorem det_vecMulVec [Nontrivial n] (u v : n → R) : (vecMulVec u v).det = 0

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_const_aux
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_const_aux {A B : Matrix n n R} {s : Finset n} : ∀ (c : n → R) (_ : ∀ i, i ∉ s → c i = 0) (k : n) (_ : k ∉ s) (_ : ∀ i j, A i j = B i j + c i * B k j), det A = det B

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_const
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_const {A B : Matrix n n R} (c : n → R) (k : n) (hk : c k = 0) (A_eq : ∀ i j, A i j = B i j + c i * B k j) : det A = det B
decls.doc: If you add multiples of row `B k` to other rows, the determinant doesn't change.

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_pred_aux
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_pred_aux {n : ℕ} (k : Fin (n + 1)) : ∀ (c : Fin n → R) (_hc : ∀ i : Fin n, k < i.succ → c i = 0) {M N : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R} (_h0 : ∀ j, M 0 j = N 0 j) (_hsucc : ∀ (i : Fin n) (j), M i.succ j = N i.succ j + c i * M (Fin.castSucc i) j), det M = det N

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_pred
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_pred {n : ℕ} {A B : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R} (c : Fin n → R) (A_zero : ∀ j, A 0 j = B 0 j) (A_succ : ∀ (i : Fin n) (j), A i.succ j = B i.succ j + c i * A (Fin.castSucc i) j) : det A = det B
decls.doc: If you add multiples of previous rows to the next row, the determinant doesn't change.

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_of_forall_col_eq_smul_add_pred
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_of_forall_col_eq_smul_add_pred {n : ℕ} {A B : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R} (c : Fin n → R) (A_zero : ∀ i, A i 0 = B i 0) (A_succ : ∀ (i) (j : Fin n), A i j.succ = B i j.succ + c j * A i (Fin.castSucc j)) : det A = det B
decls.doc: If you add multiples of previous columns to the next columns, the determinant doesn't change.

decls.name: Matrix.det_blockDiagonal
decls.sig: theorem det_blockDiagonal {o : Type*} [Fintype o] [DecidableEq o] (M : o → Matrix n n R) : (blockDiagonal M).det = ∏ k, (M k).det

decls.name: Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁
decls.sig: theorem det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁ (A : Matrix m m R) (B : Matrix m n R) (D : Matrix n n R) : (Matrix.fromBlocks A B 0 D).det = A.det * D.det
decls.doc: The determinant of a 2×2 block matrix with the lower-left block equal to zero is the product of the determinants of the diagonal blocks. For the generalization to any number of blocks, see `Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular`.

decls.name: Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂
decls.sig: theorem det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂ (A : Matrix m m R) (C : Matrix n m R) (D : Matrix n n R) : (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 C D).det = A.det * D.det
decls.doc: The determinant of a 2×2 block matrix with the upper-right block equal to zero is the product of the determinants of the diagonal blocks. For the generalization to any number of blocks, see `Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular`.

decls.name: Matrix.det_succ_column_zero
decls.sig: theorem det_succ_column_zero {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R) : det A = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * A i 0 * det (A.submatrix i.succAbove Fin.succ)
decls.doc: Laplacian expansion of the determinant of an `n+1 × n+1` matrix along column 0.

decls.name: Matrix.det_succ_row_zero
decls.sig: theorem det_succ_row_zero {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R) : det A = ∑ j : Fin n.succ, (-1) ^ (j : ℕ) * A 0 j * det (A.submatrix Fin.succ j.succAbove)
decls.doc: Laplacian expansion of the determinant of an `n+1 × n+1` matrix along row 0.

decls.name: Matrix.det_succ_row
decls.sig: theorem det_succ_row {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R) (i : Fin n.succ) : det A = ∑ j : Fin n.succ, (-1) ^ (i + j : ℕ) * A i j * det (A.submatrix i.succAbove j.succAbove)
decls.doc: Laplacian expansion of the determinant of an `n+1 × n+1` matrix along row `i`.

decls.name: Matrix.det_succ_column
decls.sig: theorem det_succ_column {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R) (j : Fin n.succ) : det A = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, (-1) ^ (i + j : ℕ) * A i j * det (A.submatrix i.succAbove j.succAbove)
decls.doc: Laplacian expansion of the determinant of an `n+1 × n+1` matrix along column `j`.

decls.name: Matrix.det_fin_zero
decls.sig: theorem det_fin_zero {A : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 0) R} : det A = 1
decls.doc: Determinant of 0x0 matrix

decls.name: Matrix.det_fin_one
decls.sig: theorem det_fin_one (A : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) : det A = A 0 0
decls.doc: Determinant of 1x1 matrix

decls.name: Matrix.det_fin_one_of
decls.sig: theorem det_fin_one_of (a : R) : det !![a] = a

decls.name: Matrix.det_fin_two
decls.sig: theorem det_fin_two (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) : det A = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 1 0
decls.doc: Determinant of 2x2 matrix

decls.name: Matrix.det_fin_two_of
decls.sig: theorem det_fin_two_of (a b c d : R) : Matrix.det !![a, b; c, d] = a * d - b * c

decls.name: Matrix.det_fin_three
decls.sig: theorem det_fin_three (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) : det A = A 0 0 * A 1 1 * A 2 2 - A 0 0 * A 1 2 * A 2 1 - A 0 1 * A 1 0 * A 2 2 + A 0 1 * A 1 2 * A 2 0 + A 0 2 * A 1 0 * A 2 1 - A 0 2 * A 1 1 * A 2 0
decls.doc: Determinant of 3x3 matrix

decls.name: Matrix.submatrix_succAbove_det_eq_negOnePow_submatrix_succAbove_det
decls.sig: theorem submatrix_succAbove_det_eq_negOnePow_submatrix_succAbove_det {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin n) R) (hv : ∑ j, M j = 0) (j₁ j₂ : Fin (n + 1)) : (M.submatrix (Fin.succAbove j₁) id).det = Int.negOnePow (j₁ - j₂) • (M.submatrix (Fin.succAbove j₂) id).det
decls.doc: Let `M` be a `(n+1) × n` matrix whose row sums to zero. Then all the matrices obtained by deleting one row have the same determinant up to a sign.

decls.name: Matrix.submatrix_succAbove_det_eq_negOnePow_submatrix_succAbove_det'
decls.sig: theorem submatrix_succAbove_det_eq_negOnePow_submatrix_succAbove_det' {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (n + 1)) R) (hv : ∀ i, ∑ j, M i j = 0) (j₁ j₂ : Fin (n + 1)) : (M.submatrix id (Fin.succAbove j₁)).det = Int.negOnePow (j₁ - j₂) • (M.submatrix id (Fin.succAbove j₂)).det
decls.doc: Let `M` be a `(n+1) × n` matrix whose column sums to zero. Then all the matrices obtained by deleting one column have the same determinant up to a sign.

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_sum_column_mul_submatrix_succAbove_succAbove_det
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_sum_column_mul_submatrix_succAbove_succAbove_det {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R) (i₀ j₀ : Fin (n + 1)) (hv : ∀ j ≠ j₀, ∑ i, M i j = 0) : M.det = (-1) ^ (i₀ + j₀ : ℕ) * (∑ i, M i j₀) * (M.submatrix (Fin.succAbove i₀) (Fin.succAbove j₀)).det
decls.doc: Let `M` be a `(n+1) × (n+1)` matrix. Assume that all columns, but the `j₀`-column, sums to zero. Then its determinant is, up to sign, the sum of the `j₀`-column times the determinant of the matrix obtained by deleting any row and the `j₀`-column.

decls.name: Matrix.det_eq_sum_row_mul_submatrix_succAbove_succAbove_det
decls.sig: theorem det_eq_sum_row_mul_submatrix_succAbove_succAbove_det {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R) (i₀ j₀ : Fin (n + 1)) (hv : ∀ i ≠ i₀, ∑ j, M i j = 0) : M.det = (-1) ^ (i₀ + j₀ : ℕ) * (∑ j, M i₀ j) * (M.submatrix (Fin.succAbove i₀) (Fin.succAbove j₀)).det
decls.doc: Let `M` be a `(n+1) × (n+1)` matrix. Assume that all rows, but the `i₀`-row, sums to zero. Then its determinant is, up to sign, the sum of the `i₀`-row times the determinant of the matrix obtained by deleting the `i₀`-row and any column.

decls.name: Matrix.IsTotallyNonneg

decls.doc: A matrix is totally nonnegative if all its finite minors have nonnegative determinant.

decls.name: Matrix.IsTotallyUnimodular
decls.sig: def IsTotallyUnimodular (A : Matrix m n R) : Prop
decls.doc: `A.IsTotallyUnimodular` means that every square submatrix of `A` (not necessarily contiguous) has determinant `0` or `1` or `-1`; that is, the determinant is in the range of `SignType.cast`.

decls.name: Matrix.isTotallyUnimodular_iff
decls.sig: lemma isTotallyUnimodular_iff (A : Matrix m n R) : A.IsTotallyUnimodular ↔ ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ f : Fin k → m, ∀ g : Fin k → n, (A.submatrix f g).det ∈ Set.range SignType.cast

decls.name: Matrix.isTotallyUnimodular_iff_fintype.

decls.name: Matrix.IsTotallyUnimodular.apply
decls.sig: lemma IsTotallyUnimodular.apply {A : Matrix m n R} (hA : A.IsTotallyUnimodular) (i : m) (j : n) : A i j ∈ Set.range SignType.cast

decls.sig: lemma IsTotallyUnimodular.fromRows_unitlike [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix m n R} {B : Matrix m' n R} (hA : A.IsTotallyUnimodular) (hB : Nonempty n → ∀ i : m', ∃ j : n, ∃ s : SignType, B i = Pi.single j s.cast) : (fromRows A B).IsTotallyUnimodular

decls.name: Matrix.fromRows_isTotallyUnimodular_iff_rows
decls.sig: lemma fromRows_isTotallyUnimodular_iff_rows [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix m n R} {B : Matrix m' n R} (hB : Nonempty n → ∀ i : m', ∃ j : n, ∃ s : SignType, B i = Pi.single j s.cast) : (fromRows A B).IsTotallyUnimodular ↔ A.IsTotallyUnimodular
decls.doc: If `A` is totally unimodular and each row of `B` is all zeros except for at most a single `1`, then `fromRows A B` is totally unimodular.

decls.name: Matrix.fromRows_one_isTotallyUnimodular_iff

decls.name: Matrix.fromCols_one_isTotallyUnimodular_iff

decls.name: BirdDet.sumFrom_eq_sum_Ico
decls.sig: theorem sumFrom_eq_sum_Ico {lo : ℕ} (f : ℕ → R) : BirdDet.sumFrom n lo f = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico lo n, f k
decls.doc: `sumFrom n lo f` is the sum of `f` over the half-open interval `[lo, n)`.

decls.name: BirdDet.sumFrom_fin_tail
decls.sig: theorem sumFrom_fin_tail (i : Fin n) (f : ℕ → R) : BirdDet.sumFrom n (i.val + 1) f = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioi i, f k.val

decls.name: BirdDet.iterate_stepEntry_get_eq_spec
decls.sig: theorem iterate_stepEntry_get_eq_spec (A : Array R) (hA : A.size = n * n) (t : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) : ((stepEntry n A)^[t] (BirdDet.get n A)) i.val j.val = (Spec.stepEntry (.ofArray A hA))^[t] (.ofArray A hA) i j
decls.doc: The scalar recurrence initialized by array lookup agrees pointwise with the matrix recurrence.

decls.name: BirdDet.birdDet_eq_birdDetSpec
decls.sig: theorem birdDet_eq_birdDetSpec (A : Array R) (hA : A.size = n * n) : birdDet n A = Spec.birdDet (.ofArray A hA)
decls.doc: The flat-array algorithm `BirdDet.birdDet` computes the same determinant as `BirdDet.Spec.birdDet`.

decls.name: BirdDet.bminor
decls.sig: abbrev bminor (i j : Fin n) (α : Fin p → Fin n) : R
decls.doc: Bird's bordered minor `f[iα, jα]`.

decls.name: BirdDet.pminor
decls.sig: abbrev pminor (α : Fin p → Fin n) : R
decls.doc: Bird's principal minor `f[α, α]`.

decls.name: BirdDet.det_submatrix_removeNth_eq_sign_mul_bminor
decls.sig: lemma det_submatrix_removeNth_eq_sign_mul_bminor (α : Fin (p + 1) → Fin n) (i : Fin n) (s : Fin (p + 1)) : (A.submatrix (Fin.cons i (s.removeNth α)) α).det = (-1 : R) ^ s.val * bminor A i (α s) (s.removeNth α)

decls.name: BirdDet.det_bordered_expand
decls.sig: theorem det_bordered_expand (α : Fin (p + 1) → Fin n) (i j : Fin n) : bminor A i j α = pminor A α * A i j - ∑ s : Fin (p + 1), bminor A i (α s) (s.removeNth α) * A (α s) j
decls.doc: First-column Laplace expansion of a bordered minor

decls.name: BirdDet.bminor_eq_zero_of_mem_range
decls.sig: theorem bminor_eq_zero_of_mem_range {k : Fin n} (α : Fin p → Fin n) (i : Fin n) (hk : k ∈ Set.range α) : bminor A i k α = 0
decls.doc: A bordered minor is zero when its border column already occurs in the word.

decls.name: BirdDet.S
decls.sig: def S (p : ℕ) (i : Fin n) : Finset (Fin p → Fin n)
decls.doc: `S p i` is Bird's `Sₚ(βᵢ)`: words `α` of length `p` over the alphabet `βᵢ`.

decls.name: BirdDet.mem_S_iff
decls.sig: theorem mem_S_iff {p : ℕ} {i : Fin n} {α : Fin p → Fin n} : α ∈ S p i ↔ StrictMono (Fin.cons i α)
decls.doc: Membership in `S p i` is strict monotonicity of the bordered word.

decls.name: BirdDet.S_zero
decls.sig: theorem S_zero (i : Fin n) : S 0 i = {![]}
decls.doc: The base case of equation (1): `S₀(α) = {ε}`, the singleton of the empty word `ε`.

decls.name: BirdDet.S_zero_eq_singleton
decls.sig: @[simp] lemma S_zero_eq_singleton {p : ℕ} : S p 0 = {Fin.succ}
decls.doc: The unique maximum-length word over the symbols above `0` is `Fin.succ`.

decls.name: BirdDet.S_succ_eq_biUnion
decls.sig: theorem S_succ_eq_biUnion {p : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : S (p + 1) i = (Finset.Ioi i).biUnion fun k ↦ (S p k).image (Fin.cons k)
decls.doc: `S (p + 1) i` can be written as the image of a `biUnion`

decls.name: BirdDet.exists_insertNth_mem_S
decls.sig: lemma exists_insertNth_mem_S {p : ℕ} {i : Fin n} {α : Fin p → Fin n} {k : Fin n} (hα : α ∈ S p i) (hik : i < k) (hk : k ∉ Set.range α) : ∃ t : Fin (p + 1), t.insertNth k α ∈ S (p + 1) i
decls.doc: A symbol above `i` that does not occur in a word in `S p i` can be inserted while preserving strict monotonicity.

decls.name: BirdDet.Eq1
decls.sig: abbrev Eq1 : Prop
decls.doc: Bird's equation (1) : `x^(p)_ij = (-1)^p ∑ { f[iα, jα] | α ∈ S_p(βᵢ) }`.

decls.name: BirdDet.paper_eq2
decls.sig: theorem paper_eq2 (i : Fin n) (hEq1 : Eq1 A p) : (-∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (Spec.stepEntry A)^[p] A k k) = (-1) ^ (p + 1) * ∑ α ∈ S (p + 1) i, pminor A α
decls.doc: Bird's equation (2), assuming equation (1) at `p` as the induction hypothesis.

decls.name: BirdDet.paper_eq3
decls.sig: theorem paper_eq3 (i j : Fin n) (hEq1 : Eq1 A p) : ((Spec.stepEntry A)^[p + 1] A) i j = (-1) ^ (p + 1) * (∑ α ∈ S (p + 1) i, pminor A α * A i j - ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioi i, ∑ α ∈ S p i, bminor A i k α * A k j)
decls.doc: Bird's equation (3), assuming equation (1) at `p` as the induction hypothesis.

decls.name: BirdDet.paper_eq5
decls.sig: theorem paper_eq5 (i j : Fin n) : ∑ α ∈ S (p + 1) i, bminor A i j α = ∑ α ∈ S (p + 1) i, pminor A α * A i j - ∑ α ∈ S (p + 1) i, ∑ t : Fin (p + 1), bminor A i (α t) (t.removeNth α) * A (α t) j
decls.doc: Bird's equation (5)

decls.name: BirdDet.paper_eq3_eq5_off_diag
decls.sig: theorem paper_eq3_eq5_off_diag (i j : Fin n) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioi i, ∑ α ∈ S p i, bminor A i k α * A k j = ∑ α' ∈ S (p + 1) i, ∑ t : Fin (p + 1), bminor A i (α' t) (t.removeNth α') * A (α' t) j
decls.doc: The off-diagonal sums in Bird's equations (3) and (5) agree.

decls.name: BirdDet.paper_eq1
decls.sig: theorem paper_eq1 : Eq1 A p

decls.name: BirdDet.birdDetSpec_eq_det
decls.sig: theorem birdDetSpec_eq_det (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) : Matrix.det A = Spec.birdDet A
decls.doc: Bird's Theorem 1

decls.name: BirdDet.det_eq_birdDet
decls.sig: public theorem det_eq_birdDet (A : Array R) (hA : A.size = n * n) : Matrix.det (.ofArray A hA) = birdDet n A
decls.doc: `BirdDet.birdDet n A` computes the determinant of the `n × n` matrix whose entries are stored in row-major order in `A`.

decls.name: BirdDet.get
decls.sig: protected def get (n : ℕ) (A : Array R) (i j : ℕ) : R
decls.doc: `get n A i j` returns the (i, j)th entry of the `n × n` matrix whose entries are stored in `A` in row-major order. The function does not check the matrix index bounds.

decls.name: BirdDet.sumFrom
decls.sig: protected def sumFrom (n lo : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) : R
decls.doc: Sum `f lo + ... + f (n - 1)`. Returns zero when `n <= lo`.

decls.name: BirdDet.stepEntry
decls.sig: def stepEntry (n : ℕ) (A : Array R) (F : ℕ → ℕ → R) (i j : ℕ) : R
decls.doc: One entry of one scalar Bird recurrence step. Bird's paper defines a matrix recursion for an `n × n` matrix `A`: ``` F_0 = A F_{t+1} = μ(F_t) * A ``` where `μ(F_t)` is obtained from `F_t` by replacing each diagonal entry `F_t k k` with the negative sum of the diagonal entries below it, setting the e

decls.name: BirdDet.birdDet
decls.sig: def birdDet (n : ℕ) (A : Array R) : R
decls.doc: `birdDet n A` computes the determinant of the `n × n` matrix whose entries are stored in `A` in row-major order.

decls.name: BirdDet.get_eq
decls.sig: theorem get_eq (n : ℕ) (A : Array R) (i j : ℕ) : BirdDet.get n A i j = A.getD (n * i + j) 0
decls.doc: Unfold a row-major matrix entry lookup.

decls.name: BirdDet.sumFrom_step
decls.sig: theorem sumFrom_step (n lo : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) (h : lo < n) : BirdDet.sumFrom n lo f = f lo + BirdDet.sumFrom n (lo + 1) f

decls.name: BirdDet.sumFrom_stop
decls.sig: theorem sumFrom_stop (n lo : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) (h : ¬ lo < n) : BirdDet.sumFrom n lo f = 0

decls.name: BirdDet.sumFrom_induct
decls.sig: theorem sumFrom_induct (n : ℕ) (motive : ℕ → Prop) (step : ∀ lo, lo < n → motive (lo + 1) → motive lo) (stop : ∀ lo, ¬lo < n → motive lo) (lo : ℕ) : motive lo
decls.doc: Induction following the recursive structure of `sumFrom`.

decls.name: BirdDet.stepEntry_eq
decls.sig: theorem stepEntry_eq (n : ℕ) (A : Array R) (F : ℕ → ℕ → R) (i j : ℕ) : stepEntry n A F i j = -(BirdDet.sumFrom n (i + 1) fun k => F k k) * BirdDet.get n A i j + BirdDet.sumFrom n (i + 1) fun k => F i k * BirdDet.get n A k j
decls.doc: Unfold one scalar Bird recurrence step to the entry-wise formula.

decls.name: BirdDet.birdDet_zero
decls.sig: theorem birdDet_zero (A : Array R) : birdDet 0 A = 1

decls.name: BirdDet.birdDet_succ
decls.sig: theorem birdDet_succ (k : ℕ) (A : Array R) : birdDet (k + 1) A = (-1 : R) ^ k * (stepEntry (k + 1) A)^[k] (BirdDet.get (k + 1) A) 0 0
decls.doc: Unfold `birdDet` at a successor dimension.

decls.name: BirdDet.birdDet_eq
decls.sig: theorem birdDet_eq (n k : ℕ) (A : Array R) (hn : n = k + 1) : birdDet n A = (-1 : R) ^ k * (stepEntry n A)^[k] (BirdDet.get n A) 0 0

decls.name: BirdDet.Spec.stepEntry
decls.sig: def stepEntry {n : ℕ} (A F : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R
decls.doc: One entry of one Matrix/Fin Bird recurrence step.

decls.name: BirdDet.Spec.birdDet
decls.sig: def birdDet {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) : R
decls.doc: A version of the Bird determinant algorithm that is stated in terms of `Matrix`.

decls.name: BirdDet.Spec.stepEntry_eq
decls.sig: theorem stepEntry_eq {n : ℕ} (A F : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) : stepEntry A F = .of fun i j ↦ (-∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioi i, F k k) * A i j + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioi i, F i k * A k j

decls.name: BirdDet.Spec.birdDetSpec_zero
decls.sig: @[simp] theorem birdDetSpec_zero (A : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 0) R) : birdDet A = 1

decls.name: BirdDet.Spec.birdDetSpec_succ
decls.sig: theorem birdDetSpec_succ {k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) R) : birdDet A = (-1 : R) ^ k * (stepEntry A)^[k] A 0 0

decls.name: Matrix.IsRowEchelon
decls.sig: def IsRowEchelon [LT m] [LT n] (A : Matrix m n R) : Prop
decls.doc: `A` is in row echelon form: for rows `i₁ < i₂`, if the higher row `i₁` is zero at every column strictly left of `j₂`, then the lower row `i₂` is zero at `j₂`.

decls.name: Matrix.IsRowEchelon.row_eq_zero_of_lt
decls.sig: theorem IsRowEchelon.row_eq_zero_of_lt [LT m] [LT n] {i₁ i₂ : m} (he : A.IsRowEchelon) (hlt : i₁ < i₂) (h0 : A i₁ = 0) : A i₂ = 0
decls.doc: In an echelon matrix, rows below a zero row are zero.

decls.name: Matrix.IsLeadingEntry
decls.sig: def IsLeadingEntry [LT n] (A : Matrix m n R) (i : m) (c : n) : Prop
decls.doc: `c` is the leading position of row `i`.

decls.name: Matrix.IsLeadingEntry.row_ne_zero
decls.sig: theorem IsLeadingEntry.row_ne_zero [LT n] {i : m} {c : n} (hc : A.IsLeadingEntry i c) : A i ≠ 0

decls.name: Matrix.row_ne_zero_iff_exists_isLeadingEntry
decls.sig: theorem row_ne_zero_iff_exists_isLeadingEntry [LT n] [WellFoundedLT n] {i : m} : A i ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ c, A.IsLeadingEntry i c

decls.name: Matrix.IsLeadingEntry.unique
decls.sig: theorem IsLeadingEntry.unique [LinearOrder n] {i : m} {c₁ c₂ : n} (h₁ : A.IsLeadingEntry i c₁) (h₂ : A.IsLeadingEntry i c₂) : c₁ = c₂
decls.doc: If column indices have a linear order, then there's at most one leading position per row.

decls.name: Matrix.IsReducedRowEchelon
decls.sig: structure IsReducedRowEchelon [LT m] [LT n] [One R] (A : Matrix m n R) : Prop where
decls.doc: `A` is in reduced row echelon form: it is in row echelon form, each leading entry is `1`, and entries above a leading entry vanish (entries below one vanish by `isRowEchelon`).

NB: The certificate does not represent the standard Hessenberg reduc

decls.name: Matrix.toQuiver
decls.sig: def toQuiver (A : Matrix n n R) : Quiver n
decls.doc: The directed graph (quiver) associated with a matrix `A`, with an edge `i ⟶ j` iff `0 < A i j`.

decls.name: Matrix.IsIrreducible
decls.sig: @[mk_iff] structure IsIrreducible (A : Matrix n n R) : Prop where
decls.doc: A matrix `A` is irreducible if it is entrywise nonnegative and its quiver of positive entries (`toQuiver A`) is strongly connected.

decls.name: Matrix.IsPrimitive
decls.sig: @[mk_iff] structure IsPrimitive [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n R) : Prop where
decls.doc: A matrix `A` is primitive if it is entrywise nonnegative and some positive power has all entries strictly positive.

decls.name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.exists_pos
decls.sig: lemma IsIrreducible.exists_pos [Nontrivial n] (h_irr : IsIrreducible A) (i : n) : ∃ j, 0 < A i j
decls.doc: If `A` is irreducible and `n` is non-trivial then every row has a positive entry.

decls.name: Matrix.pow_apply_pos_iff_nonempty_path
decls.sig: theorem pow_apply_pos_iff_nonempty_path [Fintype n] [IsOrderedRing R] [PosMulStrictMono R] [Nontrivial R] [DecidableEq n] (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (k : ℕ) (i j : n) : letI
decls.doc: For a matrix `A` with nonnegative entries, the `(i, j)`-entry of the `k`-th power `A ^ k` is strictly positive if and only if there exists a path of length `k` from `i` to `j` in the quiver associated to `A` via `toQuiver`.

decls.name: Matrix.isIrreducible_iff_exists_pow_pos
decls.sig: theorem isIrreducible_iff_exists_pow_pos [Fintype n] [IsOrderedRing R] [PosMulStrictMono R] [Nontrivial R] [DecidableEq n] (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) : IsIrreducible A ↔ ∀ i j, ∃ k > 0, 0 < (A ^ k) i j
decls.doc: Irreducibility of a nonnegative matrix `A` is equivalent to entrywise positivity of some power: between any two indices `i, j` there exists a positive integer `k` such that the `(i, j)`-entry of `A ^ k` is strictly positive.

decls.name: Matrix.IsPrimitive.isIrreducible
decls.sig: theorem IsPrimitive.isIrreducible [Fintype n] [IsOrderedRing R] [PosMulStrictMono R] [Nontrivial R] [DecidableEq n] (h_prim : IsPrimitive A) : IsIrreducible A
decls.doc: If a nonnegative square matrix `A` is primitive, then `A` is irreducible.

decls.name: Matrix.transposePath
decls.sig: def transposePath {i j : n} (p : @Quiver.Path n A.toQuiver i j) : @Quiver.Path n Aᵀ.toQuiver j i
decls.doc: Reverse a path in `toQuiver A` to a path in `toQuiver Aᵀ`, swapping endpoints.

decls.name: Matrix.IsIrreducible.transpose
decls.sig: theorem IsIrreducible.transpose (hA : IsIrreducible A) : IsIrreducible Aᵀ
decls.doc: Irreducibility is invariant under transpose.

decls.name: Matrix.isIrreducible_transpose_iff
decls.sig: theorem isIrreducible_transpose_iff : Aᵀ.IsIrreducible ↔ A.IsIrreducible

decls.name: MathExam.Plane
decls.sig: abbrev Plane
decls.doc: Mặt phẳng Euclid ℝ² (chuẩn Euclid, khác với `ℝ × ℝ` dùng chuẩn max).

decls.name: MathExam.e₁
decls.sig: noncomputable def e₁ : Plane
decls.doc: Vector cơ sở `e₁ = (1, 0)` và `e₂ = (0, 1)`.

decls.name: MathExam.e₂
decls.sig: noncomputable def e₂ : Plane
decls.doc: Vector cơ sở `e₁ = (1, 0)` và `e₂ = (0, 1)`.

decls.name: MathExam.arcLength
decls.sig: noncomputable def arcLength (γ : ℝ → Plane) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: Độ dài cung của đường cong `γ` trên `[a, b]` (định nghĩa theo mirajcs/IsoperimetricInequality).

decls.name: MathExam.paramCurve
decls.sig: noncomputable def paramCurve (x y : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ → Plane
decls.doc: Đường cong tham số `t ↦ (x(t), y(t))`.

decls.name: MathExam.graphCurve
decls.sig: noncomputable def graphCurve (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ → Plane
decls.doc: Đồ thị hàm số `x ↦ (x, f(x))`.

decls.name: MathExam.polarCurve
decls.sig: noncomputable def polarCurve (r : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ → Plane
decls.doc: Đường cong trong tọa độ cực `r = r(θ)`: `θ ↦ (r(θ) cos θ, r(θ) sin θ)`.

decls.name: MathExam.norm_smul_e₁_add_smul_e₂
decls.sig: lemma norm_smul_e₁_add_smul_e₂ (u v : ℝ) : ‖u • e₁ + v • e₂‖ = √(u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)

decls.name: MathExam.hasDerivAt_paramCurve
decls.sig: lemma hasDerivAt_paramCurve {x y : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hx : DifferentiableAt ℝ x t) (hy : DifferentiableAt ℝ y t) : HasDerivAt (paramCurve x y) (deriv x t • e₁ + deriv y t • e₂) t

decls.name: MathExam.norm_deriv_paramCurve
decls.sig: lemma norm_deriv_paramCurve {x y : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hx : DifferentiableAt ℝ x t) (hy : DifferentiableAt ℝ y t) : ‖deriv (paramCurve x y) t‖ = √(deriv x t ^ 2 + deriv y t ^ 2)

decls.name: MathExam.arcLength_paramCurve
decls.sig: theorem arcLength_paramCurve {x y : ℝ → ℝ} (hx : Differentiable ℝ x) (hy : Differentiable ℝ y) (a b : ℝ) : arcLength (paramCurve x y) a b = ∫ t in a..b, √(deriv x t ^ 2 + deriv y t ^ 2)
decls.doc: **Độ dài cung của đường cong tham số**: `L = ∫ₐᵇ √(x'(t)² + y'(t)²) dt`.

decls.name: MathExam.arcLength_graph
decls.sig: theorem arcLength_graph {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (a b : ℝ) : arcLength (graphCurve f) a b = ∫ x in a..b, √(1 + deriv f x ^ 2)
decls.doc: **Độ dài cung của đồ thị hàm số**: `L = ∫ₐᵇ √(1 + f'(x)²) dx`.

decls.name: MathExam.arcLength_polar
decls.sig: theorem arcLength_polar {r : ℝ → ℝ} (hr : Differentiable ℝ r) (a b : ℝ) : arcLength (polarCurve r) a b = ∫ θ in a..b, √(r θ ^ 2 + deriv r θ ^ 2)
decls.doc: **Độ dài cung trong tọa độ cực**: `L = ∫ₐᵇ √(r(θ)² + r'(θ)²) dθ`.

decls.name: MathExam.IsVerticalAsymptote
decls.sig: def IsVerticalAsymptote (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `x = a` là **tiệm cận đứng** của `f`: `f(x) → ±∞` khi `x → a⁻` hoặc `x → a⁺`.

decls.name: MathExam.IsSlantAsymptoteAtTop
decls.sig: def IsSlantAsymptoteAtTop (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `y = a x + b` là **tiệm cận xiên** của `f` khi `x → +∞`: `f(x) - (a x + b) → 0`.

decls.name: MathExam.IsSlantAsymptoteAtBot
decls.sig: def IsSlantAsymptoteAtBot (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `y = a x + b` là **tiệm cận xiên** của `f` khi `x → -∞`.

decls.name: MathExam.IsHorizontalAsymptoteAtTop
decls.sig: def IsHorizontalAsymptoteAtTop (f : ℝ → ℝ) (b : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `y = b` là **tiệm cận ngang** của `f` khi `x → +∞`.

decls.name: MathExam.IsHorizontalAsymptoteAtBot
decls.sig: def IsHorizontalAsymptoteAtBot (f : ℝ → ℝ) (b : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `y = b` là **tiệm cận ngang** của `f` khi `x → -∞`.

decls.name: MathExam.isHorizontalAsymptoteAtTop_iff
decls.sig: theorem isHorizontalAsymptoteAtTop_iff : IsHorizontalAsymptoteAtTop f b ↔ IsSlantAsymptoteAtTop f 0 b
decls.doc: Tiệm cận ngang là tiệm cận xiên với hệ số góc `0`.

decls.name: MathExam.isHorizontalAsymptoteAtBot_iff
decls.sig: theorem isHorizontalAsymptoteAtBot_iff : IsHorizontalAsymptoteAtBot f b ↔ IsSlantAsymptoteAtBot f 0 b

decls.name: MathExam.isSlantAsymptoteAtTop_iff
decls.sig: theorem isSlantAsymptoteAtTop_iff : IsSlantAsymptoteAtTop f a b ↔ Tendsto (fun x => f x / x) atTop (𝓝 a) ∧ Tendsto (fun x => f x - a * x) atTop (𝓝 b)
decls.doc: **Công thức tính tiệm cận xiên** (x → +∞): `y = a x + b` là tiệm cận xiên ⇔ `a = lim f(x)/x` và `b = lim (f(x) - a x)`.

decls.name: MathExam.isSlantAsymptoteAtBot_iff
decls.sig: theorem isSlantAsymptoteAtBot_iff : IsSlantAsymptoteAtBot f a b ↔ Tendsto (fun x => f x / x) atBot (𝓝 a) ∧ Tendsto (fun x => f x - a * x) atBot (𝓝 b)
decls.doc: **Công thức tính tiệm cận xiên** (x → -∞).

decls.name: MathExam.IsInflectionPoint
decls.sig: def IsInflectionPoint (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `c` là **điểm uốn** của `f`: điểm phân cách giữa một cung lồi chặt và một cung lõm chặt (theo một trong hai chiều) trên lân cận `[c - δ, c + δ]`. (Lồi ở đây theo nghĩa `ConvexOn` của Mathlib, tức "lõm lên" `f'' > 0`.)

decls.name: MathExam.isInflectionPoint_of_deriv2_sign
decls.sig: theorem isInflectionPoint_of_deriv2_sign {c δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (c - δ) (c + δ))) (h : (∀ x ∈ Ioo (c - δ) c, 0 < deriv^[2] f x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Ioo c (c + δ), deriv^[2] f x < 0) ∨ (∀ x ∈ Ioo (c - δ) c, deriv^[2] f x < 0) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Ioo c (c + δ), 0 < deriv^[2] f x)) : IsInflectionPoint f c
decls.doc: **Dấu hiệu điểm uốn**: `f` liên tục trên `[c-δ, c+δ]` và `f''` đổi dấu khi đi qua `c` (dương bên trái, âm bên phải hoặc ngược lại) thì `c` là điểm uốn.

decls.name: MathExam.HasLeftLimit
decls.sig: def HasLeftLimit (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a L : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `f` có **giới hạn trái hữu hạn** `L` tại `a`.

decls.name: MathExam.HasRightLimit
decls.sig: def HasRightLimit (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a L : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `f` có **giới hạn phải hữu hạn** `L` tại `a`.

decls.name: MathExam.IsRemovableDiscontinuity
decls.sig: def IsRemovableDiscontinuity (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `a` là **điểm gián đoạn khử được** của `f`: tồn tại `lim_{x→a} f(x) = L` hữu hạn nhưng `L ≠ f(a)`.

decls.name: MathExam.IsJumpDiscontinuity
decls.sig: def IsJumpDiscontinuity (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `a` là **điểm gián đoạn bước nhảy** của `f`: giới hạn trái `L₁`, giới hạn phải `L₂` hữu hạn và `L₁ ≠ L₂` (bước nhảy `|L₂ - L₁|`).

decls.name: MathExam.IsFirstKindDiscontinuity
decls.sig: def IsFirstKindDiscontinuity (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `a` là **điểm gián đoạn loại 1** của `f`: khử được hoặc bước nhảy.

decls.name: MathExam.IsSecondKindDiscontinuity
decls.sig: def IsSecondKindDiscontinuity (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `a` là **điểm gián đoạn loại 2** của `f`: ít nhất một giới hạn một phía không tồn tại hữu hạn.

decls.name: MathExam.tendsto_nhdsNE_iff_left_right
decls.sig: theorem tendsto_nhdsNE_iff_left_right {L : ℝ} : Tendsto f (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 L) ↔ HasLeftLimit f a L ∧ HasRightLimit f a L
decls.doc: Giới hạn hai phía tồn tại ⇔ giới hạn trái và phải tồn tại và bằng nhau.

decls.name: MathExam.continuousAt_iff_left_right_limit
decls.sig: theorem continuousAt_iff_left_right_limit : ContinuousAt f a ↔ HasLeftLimit f a (f a) ∧ HasRightLimit f a (f a)
decls.doc: **Tiêu chuẩn liên tục**: `f` liên tục tại `a` ⇔ `f(a⁻) = f(a⁺) = f(a)`.

decls.name: MathExam.IsRemovableDiscontinuity.not_continuousAt
decls.sig: theorem IsRemovableDiscontinuity.not_continuousAt (h : IsRemovableDiscontinuity f a) : ¬ ContinuousAt f a

decls.name: MathExam.IsJumpDiscontinuity.not_continuousAt
decls.sig: theorem IsJumpDiscontinuity.not_continuousAt (h : IsJumpDiscontinuity f a) : ¬ ContinuousAt f a

decls.name: MathExam.IsSecondKindDiscontinuity.not_continuousAt
decls.sig: theorem IsSecondKindDiscontinuity.not_continuousAt (h : IsSecondKindDiscontinuity f a) : ¬ ContinuousAt f a

decls.name: MathExam.isRemovableDiscontinuity_iff
decls.sig: theorem isRemovableDiscontinuity_iff : IsRemovableDiscontinuity f a ↔ ∃ L, HasLeftLimit f a L ∧ HasRightLimit f a L ∧ L ≠ f a
decls.doc: Gián đoạn khử được ⇔ giới hạn trái và phải bằng nhau (`= L`) và khác `f(a)`.

decls.name: MathExam.discontinuity_trichotomy
decls.sig: theorem discontinuity_trichotomy (h : ¬ ContinuousAt f a) : IsRemovableDiscontinuity f a ∨ IsJumpDiscontinuity f a ∨ IsSecondKindDiscontinuity f a
decls.doc: **Định lý phân loại**: mọi điểm gián đoạn đều thuộc đúng một trong ba loại: khử được, bước nhảy, loại 2.

decls.name: MathExam.not_isFirstKind_and_isSecondKind
decls.sig: theorem not_isFirstKind_and_isSecondKind : ¬ (IsFirstKindDiscontinuity f a ∧ IsSecondKindDiscontinuity f a)
decls.doc: Gián đoạn loại 1 và loại 2 loại trừ nhau.

decls.name: MathExam.isSecondKindDiscontinuity_of_tendsto_atTop_right
decls.sig: theorem isSecondKindDiscontinuity_of_tendsto_atTop_right (h : Tendsto f (𝓝[>] a) atTop) : IsSecondKindDiscontinuity f a
decls.doc: Tiệm cận đứng một phía (`f → ±∞`) cho gián đoạn loại 2.

decls.name: MathExam.isSecondKindDiscontinuity_of_tendsto_atTop_left
decls.sig: theorem isSecondKindDiscontinuity_of_tendsto_atTop_left (h : Tendsto f (𝓝[<] a) atTop) : IsSecondKindDiscontinuity f a

decls.name: MathExam.isSecondKindDiscontinuity_of_tendsto_atBot_right
decls.sig: theorem isSecondKindDiscontinuity_of_tendsto_atBot_right (h : Tendsto f (𝓝[>] a) atBot) : IsSecondKindDiscontinuity f a

decls.name: MathExam.isSecondKindDiscontinuity_of_tendsto_atBot_left
decls.sig: theorem isSecondKindDiscontinuity_of_tendsto_atBot_left (h : Tendsto f (𝓝[<] a) atBot) : IsSecondKindDiscontinuity f a

decls.name: MathExam.hessianMatrix
decls.sig: noncomputable def hessianMatrix (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ) (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ
decls.doc: **Ma trận Hessian** của `f` tại `x₀`: `H i j = D²f(x₀)(eᵢ, eⱼ)`.

decls.name: MathExam.hessianMatrix_apply
decls.sig: theorem hessianMatrix_apply (i j : Fin n) : hessianMatrix f x₀ i j = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x₀ (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)
decls.doc: Phần tử Hessian là đạo hàm riêng cấp hai: `H i j = (∂ⱼ (∂ᵢ f))(x₀)` viết bằng `fderiv`.

decls.name: MathExam.hessianMatrix_symm
decls.sig: theorem hessianMatrix_symm (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x₀) (i j : Fin n) : hessianMatrix f x₀ j i = hessianMatrix f x₀ i j
decls.doc: Định lý Schwarz: Hessian đối xứng khi `f` thuộc lớp C² tại `x₀`.

decls.name: MathExam.iteratedFDeriv_two_eq_sum
decls.sig: theorem iteratedFDeriv_two_eq_sum (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x₀ ![v, v] = ∑ i, ∑ j, v i * v j * hessianMatrix f x₀ i j
decls.doc: `D²f(x₀)(v, v) = ∑ᵢ ∑ⱼ vᵢ vⱼ Hᵢⱼ`.

decls.name: MathExam.isLocalMin_of_hessianMatrix_posDef
decls.sig: theorem isLocalMin_of_hessianMatrix_posDef (h₀ : gradient f x₀ = 0) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x₀) (hH : (hessianMatrix f x₀).PosDef) : IsLocalMin f x₀
decls.doc: **Hessian xác định dương tại điểm dừng ⇒ cực tiểu địa phương.**

decls.name: MathExam.gradient_neg_eq
decls.sig: lemma gradient_neg_eq (h₀ : gradient f x₀ = 0) : gradient (fun x => -f x) x₀ = 0

decls.name: MathExam.hessianMatrix_neg
decls.sig: lemma hessianMatrix_neg : hessianMatrix (fun x => -f x) x₀ = -hessianMatrix f x₀

decls.name: MathExam.isLocalMax_of_neg_hessianMatrix_posDef
decls.sig: theorem isLocalMax_of_neg_hessianMatrix_posDef (h₀ : gradient f x₀ = 0) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x₀) (hH : (-hessianMatrix f x₀).PosDef) : IsLocalMax f x₀
decls.doc: **Hessian xác định âm (−H xác định dương) tại điểm dừng ⇒ cực đại địa phương.**

decls.name: MathExam.hessianMatrix_fin_two
decls.sig: lemma hessianMatrix_fin_two (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x₀) : hessianMatrix f x₀ = !![hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 0, hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 1; hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 1, hessianMatrix f x₀ 1 1]

decls.name: MathExam.isLocalMin_of_hessian_two
decls.sig: theorem isLocalMin_of_hessian_two (h₀ : gradient f x₀ = 0) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x₀) (hA : 0 < hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 0) (hΔ : 0 < hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 0 * hessianMatrix f x₀ 1 1 - hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 1 ^ 2) : IsLocalMin f x₀
decls.doc: **Cực tiểu hàm hai biến**: điểm dừng, `A > 0` và `AC - B² > 0` ⇒ cực tiểu địa phương.

decls.name: MathExam.isLocalMax_of_hessian_two
decls.sig: theorem isLocalMax_of_hessian_two (h₀ : gradient f x₀ = 0) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x₀) (hA : hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 0 < 0) (hΔ : 0 < hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 0 * hessianMatrix f x₀ 1 1 - hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 1 ^ 2) : IsLocalMax f x₀
decls.doc: **Cực đại hàm hai biến**: điểm dừng, `A < 0` và `AC - B² > 0` ⇒ cực đại địa phương.

decls.name: MathExam.hessianMatrix_fin_three
decls.sig: lemma hessianMatrix_fin_three (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x₀) : hessianMatrix f x₀ = !![hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 0, hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 1, hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 2; hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 1, hessianMatrix f x₀ 1 1, hessianMatrix f x₀ 1 2; hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 2, hessianMatrix f x₀ 1 2, hessianMatrix f x₀ 2 2]

decls.name: MathExam.isLocalMin_of_hessian_three
decls.sig: theorem isLocalMin_of_hessian_three (h₀ : gradient f x₀ = 0) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x₀) (h1 : 0 < hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 0) (h2 : 0 < hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 0 * hessianMatrix f x₀ 1 1 - hessianMatrix f x₀ 0 1 ^ 2) (h3 : 0 < (hessianMatrix f x₀).det) : IsLocalMin f x₀
decls.doc: **Cực tiểu hàm ba biến** (Sylvester): điểm dừng, ba định thức con chính `Δ₁, Δ₂, Δ₃ > 0` ⇒ cực tiểu địa phương.

decls.name: MathExam.IsInfinitesimal
decls.sig: def IsInfinitesimal (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `f` là **vô cùng bé** khi `x → a`: `f(x) → 0` khi `x → a` (`x ≠ a`).

decls.name: MathExam.IsInfinitesimalOfOrder
decls.sig: def IsInfinitesimalOfOrder (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : Prop
decls.doc: `f` là **VCB bậc `k`** (so với `x - a`) khi `x → a`: `f(x)/(x - a)ᵏ → c` hữu hạn, `c ≠ 0`.

decls.name: MathExam.IsHigherOrderInfinitesimal
decls.sig: def IsHigherOrderInfinitesimal (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `f` là **VCB bậc cao hơn** `g` khi `x → a`: `f = o(g)`.

decls.name: MathExam.isInfinitesimalOfOrder_of_isLittleO
decls.sig: theorem isInfinitesimalOfOrder_of_isLittleO {f : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : (fun x => f x - c * x ^ k) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ k) : IsInfinitesimalOfOrder f 0 k
decls.doc: Nếu `f(x) = c xᵏ + o(xᵏ)` với `c ≠ 0` thì `f` là VCB bậc `k` khi `x → 0`.

decls.name: MathExam.isEquivalent_of_isLittleO
decls.sig: theorem isEquivalent_of_isLittleO {f : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : (fun x => f x - c * x ^ k) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ k) : f ~[𝓝 0] fun x => c * x ^ k
decls.doc: Nếu `f(x) = c xᵏ + o(xᵏ)` với `c ≠ 0` thì `f(x) ~ c xᵏ` khi `x → 0`.

decls.name: MathExam.isEquivalent_of_hasDerivAt
decls.sig: theorem isEquivalent_of_hasDerivAt {f : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (h0 : f 0 = 0) (hd : HasDerivAt f c 0) : f ~[𝓝 0] fun x => c * x
decls.doc: Nếu `f(0) = 0` và `f'(0) = c ≠ 0` thì `f(x) ~ c x` khi `x → 0`.

decls.name: MathExam.isInfinitesimalOfOrder_of_isEquivalent
decls.sig: theorem isInfinitesimalOfOrder_of_isEquivalent {f : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : f ~[𝓝 0] fun x => c * x ^ k) : IsInfinitesimalOfOrder f 0 k
decls.doc: `f` là VCB bậc `k` khi `x → 0` nếu `f(x) ~ c xᵏ`, `c ≠ 0`.

decls.name: MathExam.tendsto_div_of_isEquivalent
decls.sig: theorem tendsto_div_of_isEquivalent {f f₁ g g₁ : ℝ → ℝ} {l : Filter ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hf : f ~[l] f₁) (hg : g ~[l] g₁) (h : Tendsto (fun x => f₁ x / g₁ x) l (𝓝 L)) : Tendsto (fun x => f x / g x) l (𝓝 L)
decls.doc: **Thay tương đương trong thương**: nếu `f ~ f₁`, `g ~ g₁` và `f₁/g₁ → L` thì `f/g → L`.

decls.name: MathExam.tendsto_mul_of_isEquivalent
decls.sig: theorem tendsto_mul_of_isEquivalent {f f₁ g g₁ : ℝ → ℝ} {l : Filter ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hf : f ~[l] f₁) (hg : g ~[l] g₁) (h : Tendsto (fun x => f₁ x * g₁ x) l (𝓝 L)) : Tendsto (fun x => f x * g x) l (𝓝 L)
decls.doc: **Thay tương đương trong tích**: nếu `f ~ f₁`, `g ~ g₁` và `f₁·g₁ → L` thì `f·g → L`.

decls.name: MathExam.sin_equiv
decls.sig: theorem sin_equiv : sin ~[𝓝 0] fun x => x

decls.name: MathExam.tan_equiv
decls.sig: theorem tan_equiv : tan ~[𝓝 0] fun x => x

decls.name: MathExam.arcsin_equiv
decls.sig: theorem arcsin_equiv : arcsin ~[𝓝 0] fun x => x

decls.name: MathExam.arctan_equiv
decls.sig: theorem arctan_equiv : arctan ~[𝓝 0] fun x => x

decls.name: MathExam.exp_sub_one_equiv
decls.sig: theorem exp_sub_one_equiv : (fun x => exp x - 1) ~[𝓝 0] fun x => x

decls.name: MathExam.log_one_add_equiv
decls.sig: theorem log_one_add_equiv : (fun x => log (1 + x)) ~[𝓝 0] fun x => x

decls.name: MathExam.one_sub_cos_equiv
decls.sig: theorem one_sub_cos_equiv : (fun x => 1 - cos x) ~[𝓝 0] fun x => 1 / 2 * x ^ 2
decls.doc: `1 - cos x ~ x²/2`.

decls.name: MathExam.one_add_rpow_sub_one_equiv
decls.sig: theorem one_add_rpow_sub_one_equiv {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) : (fun x : ℝ => (1 + x) ^ a - 1) ~[𝓝 0] fun x => a * x

decls.name: MathExam.rpow_sub_one_equiv
decls.sig: theorem rpow_sub_one_equiv {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a ≠ 1) : (fun x : ℝ => a ^ x - 1) ~[𝓝 0] fun x => log a * x

decls.name: MathExam.integral_eq_of_hasDerivAt
decls.sig: theorem integral_eq_of_hasDerivAt {f F : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hF : ∀ x ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt F (f x) x) (hf : ContinuousOn f (uIcc a b)) : ∫ x in a..b, f x = F b - F a
decls.doc: **Newton–Leibniz** cho hàm liên tục: nếu `F' = f` trên `[a, b]` thì `∫ₐᵇ f = F(b) - F(a)`. Dùng để kiểm chứng một nguyên hàm cụ thể.

decls.name: MathExam.integral_mul_exp
decls.sig: theorem integral_mul_exp (hc : c ≠ 0) : ∫ x in a..b, x * exp (c * x) = (b / c - 1 / c ^ 2) * exp (c * b) - (a / c - 1 / c ^ 2) * exp (c * a)
decls.doc: `∫ x e^(cx) dx = (x/c - 1/c²) e^(cx)`.

decls.name: MathExam.integral_mul_sin
decls.sig: theorem integral_mul_sin (hc : c ≠ 0) : ∫ x in a..b, x * sin (c * x) = (-b * cos (c * b) / c + sin (c * b) / c ^ 2) - (-a * cos (c * a) / c + sin (c * a) / c ^ 2)
decls.doc: `∫ x sin(cx) dx = -x cos(cx)/c + sin(cx)/c²`.

decls.name: MathExam.integral_mul_cos
decls.sig: theorem integral_mul_cos (hc : c ≠ 0) : ∫ x in a..b, x * cos (c * x) = (b * sin (c * b) / c + cos (c * b) / c ^ 2) - (a * sin (c * a) / c + cos (c * a) / c ^ 2)
decls.doc: `∫ x cos(cx) dx = x sin(cx)/c + cos(cx)/c²`.

decls.name: MathExam.integral_exp_mul_sin
decls.sig: theorem integral_exp_mul_sin {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p ^ 2 + q ^ 2 ≠ 0) : ∫ x in a..b, exp (p * x) * sin (q * x) = exp (p * b) * (p * sin (q * b) - q * cos (q * b)) / (p ^ 2 + q ^ 2) - exp (p * a) * (p * sin (q * a) - q * cos (q * a)) / (p ^ 2 + q ^ 2)
decls.doc: `∫ e^(px) sin(qx) dx = e^(px) (p sin(qx) - q cos(qx)) / (p² + q²)` (`p² + q² ≠ 0`).

decls.name: MathExam.integral_exp_mul_cos
decls.sig: theorem integral_exp_mul_cos {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p ^ 2 + q ^ 2 ≠ 0) : ∫ x in a..b, exp (p * x) * cos (q * x) = exp (p * b) * (p * cos (q * b) + q * sin (q * b)) / (p ^ 2 + q ^ 2) - exp (p * a) * (p * cos (q * a) + q * sin (q * a)) / (p ^ 2 + q ^ 2)
decls.doc: `∫ e^(px) cos(qx) dx = e^(px) (p cos(qx) + q sin(qx)) / (p² + q²)` (`p² + q² ≠ 0`).

decls.name: MathExam.integral_mul_log
decls.sig: theorem integral_mul_log (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : ∫ x in a..b, x * log x = (b ^ 2 * log b / 2 - b ^ 2 / 4) - (a ^ 2 * log a / 2 - a ^ 2 / 4)
decls.doc: `∫ x ln x dx = x² ln x / 2 - x²/4` trên đoạn `[a, b] ⊂ (0, +∞)`.

decls.name: MathExam.isLittleO_pow_of_le
decls.sig: theorem isLittleO_pow_of_le {f : ℝ → ℝ} {m n : ℕ} (h : f =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ m) (hnm : n ≤ m) : f =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n
decls.doc: Hạ bậc: `o(xᵐ)` cũng là `o(xⁿ)` khi `n ≤ m` (dùng để cắt khai triển về cùng một bậc).

decls.name: MathExam.isLittleO_monomial
decls.sig: theorem isLittleO_monomial (c : ℝ) {m n : ℕ} (h : n < m) : (fun x : ℝ => c * x ^ m) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n
decls.doc: Đơn thức bậc cao là vô cùng bé bậc cao hơn: `c·xᵐ = o(xⁿ)` khi `n < m`.

decls.name: MathExam.isLittleO_comp_mul_pow
decls.sig: theorem isLittleO_comp_mul_pow {F : ℝ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} (h : F =o[𝓝 0] fun y => y ^ n) (c : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : (fun x => F (c * x ^ m)) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ (n * m)
decls.doc: Thế biến trong khai triển: nếu `F(y) = o(yⁿ)` thì `F(c·xᵐ) = o(x^(n·m))`. Ví dụ: từ khai triển của `eʸ` suy ra khai triển của `e^(c x²)`.

decls.name: MathExam.isLittleO_comp_mul
decls.sig: theorem isLittleO_comp_mul {F : ℝ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} (h : F =o[𝓝 0] fun y => y ^ n) (c : ℝ) : (fun x => F (c * x)) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n
decls.doc: Thế `y = c·x` (trường hợp hay gặp nhất của `IsLittleO.comp_mul_pow`).

decls.name: MathExam.isLittleO_mul_expansion
decls.sig: theorem isLittleO_mul_expansion {f g P Q : ℝ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hf : (fun x => f x - P x) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n) (hg : (fun x => g x - Q x) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n) (hgb : g =O[𝓝 0] fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (hPb : P =O[𝓝 0] fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) : (fun x => f x * g x - P x * Q x) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n
decls.doc: Nhân hai khai triển: nếu `f = P + o(xⁿ)`, `g = Q + o(xⁿ)` và `g`, `P` bị chặn gần 0 thì `f·g = P·Q + o(xⁿ)`.

decls.name: MathExam.tendsto_div_pow_of_isLittleO
decls.sig: theorem tendsto_div_pow_of_isLittleO {f : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (h : (fun x => f x - c * x ^ n) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n) : Tendsto (fun x => f x / x ^ n) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 c)
decls.doc: Nếu `f(x) = c·xⁿ + o(xⁿ)` thì `f(x)/xⁿ → c` khi `x → 0` (`x ≠ 0`).

decls.name: MathExam.tendsto_div_of_isLittleO
decls.sig: theorem tendsto_div_of_isLittleO {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hb : b ≠ 0) (hf : (fun x => f x - a * x ^ n) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n) (hg : (fun x => g x - b * x ^ n) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n) : Tendsto (fun x => f x / g x) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (a / b))
decls.doc: **Quy tắc ngắt bỏ vô cùng bé bậc cao** (thay cho L'Hospital): nếu `f(x) = a·xⁿ + o(xⁿ)`, `g(x) = b·xⁿ + o(xⁿ)` và `b ≠ 0` thì `f(x)/g(x) → a/b` khi `x → 0`.

decls.name: MathExam.maclaurin_of_contDiff
decls.sig: theorem maclaurin_of_contDiff {f : ℝ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ n f) : (fun x => f x - ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), iteratedDeriv k f 0 / k ! * x ^ k) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n
decls.doc: **Công thức Maclaurin với phần dư Peano** cho hàm khả vi liên tục cấp `n` trên ℝ: `f(x) = ∑_{k ≤ n} f⁽ᵏ⁾(0)/k! · xᵏ + o(xⁿ)`.

decls.name: MathExam.exp_maclaurin
decls.sig: theorem exp_maclaurin (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (fun x => exp (a * x) - ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), a ^ k / k ! * x ^ k) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n
decls.doc: `e^(a x) = ∑_{k ≤ n} aᵏ/k! · xᵏ + o(xⁿ)`.

decls.name: MathExam.exp_maclaurin'
decls.sig: theorem exp_maclaurin' (n : ℕ) : (fun x => exp x - ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), x ^ k / k !) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n
decls.doc: `eˣ = ∑_{k ≤ n} xᵏ/k! + o(xⁿ)`.

decls.name: MathExam.sin_maclaurin
decls.sig: theorem sin_maclaurin (n : ℕ) : (fun x => sin x - ∑ j ∈ range n, (-1) ^ j * x ^ (2 * j + 1) / (2 * j + 1)!) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ (2 * n)

decls.name: MathExam.cos_maclaurin
decls.sig: theorem cos_maclaurin (n : ℕ) : (fun x => cos x - ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), (-1) ^ j * x ^ (2 * j) / (2 * j)!) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ (2 * n + 1)

decls.name: MathExam.sin_mul_maclaurin
decls.sig: theorem sin_mul_maclaurin (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (fun x => sin (a * x) - ∑ j ∈ range n, (-1) ^ j * (a * x) ^ (2 * j + 1) / (2 * j + 1)!) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ (2 * n)

decls.name: MathExam.cos_mul_maclaurin
decls.sig: theorem cos_mul_maclaurin (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (fun x => cos (a * x) - ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), (-1) ^ j * (a * x) ^ (2 * j) / (2 * j)!) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ (2 * n + 1)

decls.name: MathExam.isLittleO_succ_of_hasDerivAt
decls.sig: theorem isLittleO_succ_of_hasDerivAt {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hs : Convex ℝ s) (hs0 : s ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) (h0 : f 0 = 0) (hd : ∀ x ∈ s, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) (h' : f' =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n) : f =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ (n + 1)
decls.doc: Bổ đề: nếu `f(0) = 0` và `f' = o(xⁿ)` trên một lân cận lồi của 0 thì `f = o(x^(n+1))`.

decls.name: MathExam.log_one_add_maclaurin
decls.sig: theorem log_one_add_maclaurin (n : ℕ) : (fun x => log (1 + x) - ∑ k ∈ range n, (-1) ^ k * x ^ (k + 1) / (k + 1)) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n

decls.name: MathExam.arctan_maclaurin
decls.sig: theorem arctan_maclaurin (n : ℕ) : (fun x => arctan x - ∑ k ∈ range n, (-1) ^ k * x ^ (2 * k + 1) / (2 * k + 1)) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ (2 * n)
decls.doc: `arctan x = ∑_{k < n} (-1)ᵏ x^(2k+1)/(2k+1) + o(x^(2n))`. Ví dụ `n = 2`: `arctan x = x - x³/3 + o(x⁴)`.

decls.name: MathExam.choose_real_eq
decls.sig: theorem choose_real_eq (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : Ring.choose a k = (∏ i ∈ range k, (a - i)) / k !
decls.doc: Hệ số nhị thức suy rộng: `C(α, k) = α(α-1)…(α-k+1)/k!`.

decls.name: MathExam.one_add_rpow_maclaurin
decls.sig: theorem one_add_rpow_maclaurin (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (fun x : ℝ => (1 + x) ^ a - ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), Ring.choose a k * x ^ k) =o[𝓝 0] fun x => x ^ n
decls.doc: `(1 + x)^α = ∑_{k ≤ n} C(α, k) xᵏ + o(xⁿ)` với `α` thực bất kỳ (lũy thừa `rpow`). Hệ số `C(α, k)` tính bằng `choose_real_eq`. Trường hợp hay gặp: `√(1+x)` (`α = 1/2`, dùng `Real.sqrt_eq_rpow`), `1/(1+x)` (`α = -1`, dùng `Real.rpow_neg_one`).

decls.name: MathExam.partialX
decls.sig: noncomputable def partialX (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **Đạo hàm riêng theo `x`** của `f(x, y)` tại `p = (x₀, y₀)`: `f'ₓ(x₀, y₀) = d/dx f(x, y₀) |_{x₀}`.

decls.name: MathExam.partialY
decls.sig: noncomputable def partialY (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **Đạo hàm riêng theo `y`** của `f(x, y)` tại `p = (x₀, y₀)`: `f'ᵧ(x₀, y₀) = d/dy f(x₀, y) |_{y₀}`.

decls.name: MathExam.partialXX
decls.sig: noncomputable def partialXX (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ
decls.doc: Đạo hàm riêng cấp hai `f''ₓₓ = ∂/∂x (∂f/∂x)`.

decls.name: MathExam.partialXY
decls.sig: noncomputable def partialXY (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ
decls.doc: Đạo hàm riêng cấp hai hỗn hợp `f''ₓᵧ = ∂/∂y (∂f/∂x)`.

decls.name: MathExam.partialYX
decls.sig: noncomputable def partialYX (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ
decls.doc: Đạo hàm riêng cấp hai hỗn hợp `f''ᵧₓ = ∂/∂x (∂f/∂y)`.

decls.name: MathExam.partialYY
decls.sig: noncomputable def partialYY (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ
decls.doc: Đạo hàm riêng cấp hai `f''ᵧᵧ = ∂/∂y (∂f/∂y)`.

decls.name: MathExam.hasDerivAt_partialX
decls.sig: theorem hasDerivAt_partialX (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f p) : HasDerivAt (fun x => f (x, p.2)) (fderiv ℝ f p (1, 0)) p.1

decls.name: MathExam.hasDerivAt_partialY
decls.sig: theorem hasDerivAt_partialY (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f p) : HasDerivAt (fun y => f (p.1, y)) (fderiv ℝ f p (0, 1)) p.2

decls.name: MathExam.partialX_eq_fderiv
decls.sig: theorem partialX_eq_fderiv (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f p) : partialX f p = fderiv ℝ f p (1, 0)

decls.name: MathExam.partialY_eq_fderiv
decls.sig: theorem partialY_eq_fderiv (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f p) : partialY f p = fderiv ℝ f p (0, 1)

decls.name: MathExam.fderiv_apply_eq_partial
decls.sig: theorem fderiv_apply_eq_partial (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f p) (h k : ℝ) : fderiv ℝ f p (h, k) = partialX f p * h + partialY f p * k
decls.doc: **Vi phân toàn phần**: `df(x₀, y₀)(h, k) = f'ₓ h + f'ᵧ k`.

decls.name: MathExam.totalDiff_approx
decls.sig: theorem totalDiff_approx (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f p) : (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => f (p + v) - f p - (partialX f p * v.1 + partialY f p * v.2)) =o[𝓝 0] fun v => ‖v‖
decls.doc: **Công thức xấp xỉ bằng vi phân**: `f(x₀ + h, y₀ + k) = f(x₀, y₀) + f'ₓ h + f'ᵧ k + o(‖(h, k)‖)`.

decls.name: MathExam.hasDerivAt_comp_curve
decls.sig: theorem hasDerivAt_comp_curve {x y : ℝ → ℝ} {x' y' t : ℝ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (x t, y t)) (hx : HasDerivAt x x' t) (hy : HasDerivAt y y' t) : HasDerivAt (fun s => f (x s, y s)) (partialX f (x t, y t) * x' + partialY f (x t, y t) * y') t
decls.doc: **Đạo hàm hàm hợp** `z = f(x(t), y(t))`: `z'(t) = f'ₓ x'(t) + f'ᵧ y'(t)`.

decls.name: MathExam.partialX_comp
decls.sig: theorem partialX_comp {u v : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (u p, v p)) (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ u p) (hv : DifferentiableAt ℝ v p) : partialX (fun q => f (u q, v q)) p = partialX f (u p, v p) * partialX u p + partialY f (u p, v p) * partialX v p
decls.doc: **Đạo hàm riêng của hàm hợp** `z = f(u(x, y), v(x, y))`: `z'ₓ = f'ᵤ u'ₓ + f'ᵥ v'ₓ`.

decls.name: MathExam.partialY_comp
decls.sig: theorem partialY_comp {u v : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (u p, v p)) (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ u p) (hv : DifferentiableAt ℝ v p) : partialY (fun q => f (u q, v q)) p = partialX f (u p, v p) * partialY u p + partialY f (u p, v p) * partialY v p
decls.doc: **Đạo hàm riêng của hàm hợp** `z = f(u(x, y), v(x, y))`: `z'ᵧ = f'ᵤ u'ᵧ + f'ᵥ v'ᵧ`.

decls.name: MathExam.hasDerivAt_implicit
decls.sig: theorem hasDerivAt_implicit {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {φ : ℝ → ℝ} {x₀ φ' : ℝ} (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (x₀, φ x₀)) (hφ : HasDerivAt φ φ' x₀) (h0 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, F (x, φ x) = 0) (hFy : partialY F (x₀, φ x₀) ≠ 0) : φ' = -partialX F (x₀, φ x₀) / partialY F (x₀, φ x₀)
decls.doc: **Đạo hàm hàm ẩn**: nếu `y = φ(x)` khả vi, `F(x, φ(x)) = 0` trên một lân cận của `x₀` và `F'ᵧ ≠ 0` thì `φ'(x₀) = -F'ₓ / F'ᵧ`. (Sự tồn tại của `φ` do định lý hàm ẩn của Mathlib: `HasStrictFDerivAt.implicitFunction`.) Với hàm ẩn `z = z(x, y)` xác định bởi `F(x, y, z) = 0`: cố định `y = y₀` và áp dụng

decls.name: MathExam.partialXY_eq_fderiv
decls.sig: theorem partialXY_eq_fderiv (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f p) : partialXY f p = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) p (0, 1) (1, 0)

decls.name: MathExam.partialYX_eq_fderiv
decls.sig: theorem partialYX_eq_fderiv (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f p) : partialYX f p = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) p (1, 0) (0, 1)

decls.name: MathExam.partialXY_eq_partialYX
decls.sig: theorem partialXY_eq_partialYX (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f p) : partialXY f p = partialYX f p
decls.doc: **Định lý Schwarz**: nếu `f` thuộc lớp `C²` tại `p` thì `f''ₓᵧ(p) = f''ᵧₓ(p)`.

decls.name: MathExam.area_regionBetween
decls.sig: theorem area_regionBetween {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc a b)) (hfg : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, f x ≤ g x) : (volume (regionBetween f g (Icc a b))).toReal = ∫ x in a..b, (g x - f x)
decls.doc: **Diện tích miền giữa hai đồ thị** `f ≤ g` trên `[a, b]`: `S = ∫ₐᵇ (g(x) - f(x)) dx`.

decls.name: MathExam.area_parametric
decls.sig: theorem area_parametric {x x' g : ℝ → ℝ} {α β : ℝ} (hx : ∀ t ∈ uIcc α β, HasDerivAt x (x' t) t) (hx' : ContinuousOn x' (uIcc α β)) (hg : Continuous g) (hle : x α ≤ x β) (hg0 : ∀ u ∈ Icc (x α) (x β), 0 ≤ g u) : (volume (regionBetween 0 g (Icc (x α) (x β)))).toReal = ∫ t in α..β, g (x t) * x' t
decls.doc: **Diện tích hình thang cong dưới đường cong tham số** `x = x(t)`, `y = g(x(t)) ≥ 0`, `t ∈ [α, β]` (với `x(α) ≤ x(β)`): `S = ∫_α^β y(t) x'(t) dt`.

decls.name: MathExam.polarRegion
decls.sig: def polarRegion (r : ℝ → ℝ) (α β : ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)
decls.doc: **Miền phẳng trong tọa độ cực** giới hạn bởi hai tia `θ = α`, `θ = β` và đường cong `r = r(θ)`: tập các điểm `(ρ cos θ, ρ sin θ)` với `α < θ < β`, `0 < ρ < r(θ)`. (Bỏ đi phần biên — tập có diện tích 0 — để dùng được công thức đổi biến.)

decls.name: MathExam.area_polarRegion
decls.sig: theorem area_polarRegion {r : ℝ → ℝ} {α β : ℝ} (hr : Continuous r) (hα : -π ≤ α) (hβ : β ≤ π) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hr0 : ∀ θ ∈ Icc α β, 0 ≤ r θ) : (volume (polarRegion r α β)).toReal = 1 / 2 * ∫ θ in α..β, r θ ^ 2
decls.doc: **Diện tích miền trong tọa độ cực**: `S = ½ ∫_α^β r²(θ) dθ` (với `-π ≤ α ≤ β ≤ π`, `r` liên tục và `r ≥ 0` trên `[α, β]`).

decls.doc: Vector `(p, q, s)` của ℝ³.

decls.name: MathExam.norm_vec3_sq
decls.sig: lemma norm_vec3_sq (p q s : ℝ) : ‖vec3 p q s‖ ^ 2 = p ^ 2 + q ^ 2 + s ^ 2

decls.name: MathExam.inner_vec3
decls.sig: lemma inner_vec3 (p q s p' q' s' : ℝ) : inner ℝ (vec3 p q s) (vec3 p' q' s') = p * p' + q * q' + s * s'

decls.name: MathExam.hasDerivAt_vec3
decls.sig: lemma hasDerivAt_vec3 {p q s : ℝ → ℝ} {p' q' s' t : ℝ} (hp : HasDerivAt p p' t) (hq : HasDerivAt q q' t) (hs : HasDerivAt s s' t) : HasDerivAt (fun t => vec3 (p t) (q t) (s t)) (vec3 p' q' s') t

decls.name: MathExam.surfaceArea
decls.sig: noncomputable def surfaceArea (σ : ℝ → ℝ → Space) (a b α β : ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **Diện tích mặt cong tham số** `σ : [a,b] × [α,β] → ℝ³`: `S = ∫ₐᵇ ∫_α^β √(‖σᵤ‖² ‖σᵥ‖² - ⟪σᵤ, σᵥ⟫²) dv du`.

decls.name: MathExam.revSurface
decls.sig: noncomputable def revSurface (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ → Space
decls.doc: Mặt tròn xoay khi quay đồ thị `y = f(x)` quanh trục `Ox`: `(x, θ) ↦ (x, f(x) cos θ, f(x) sin θ)`.

decls.name: MathExam.surfaceArea_revSurface
decls.sig: theorem surfaceArea_revSurface {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (a b : ℝ) : surfaceArea (revSurface f) a b 0 (2 * π) = 2 * π * ∫ x in a..b, |f x| * √(1 + deriv f x ^ 2)
decls.doc: **Diện tích mặt tròn xoay** (quay quanh `Ox`): `S = 2π ∫ₐᵇ |f(x)| √(1 + f'(x)²) dx`.

decls.name: MathExam.solidOfRevolution
decls.sig: def solidOfRevolution (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) : Set (ℝ × Plane)
decls.doc: **Vật thể tròn xoay** khi quay miền `0 ≤ |y| ≤ |f(x)|, a ≤ x ≤ b` quanh trục `Ox`: tập các điểm `(x, w) ∈ ℝ × ℝ²` với `x ∈ [a, b]` và `‖w‖ ≤ |f(x)|` (`w` là tọa độ trong mặt phẳng vuông góc với `Ox`).

decls.name: MathExam.volume_solidOfRevolution
decls.sig: theorem volume_solidOfRevolution {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) : volume (solidOfRevolution f a b) = ENNReal.ofReal (π * ∫ x in a..b, f x ^ 2)
decls.doc: **Thể tích vật tròn xoay** (độ đo Lebesgue ba chiều): `V = π ∫ₐᵇ f(x)² dx`.

decls.name: MathExam.volume_real_solidOfRevolution
decls.sig: theorem volume_real_solidOfRevolution {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) : (volume (solidOfRevolution f a b)).toReal = π * ∫ x in a..b, f x ^ 2
decls.doc: Thể tích vật tròn xoay dưới dạng số thực: `V = π ∫ₐᵇ f(x)² dx`.

decls.name: MathExam.surfaceArea_revSurface_of_nonneg
decls.sig: theorem surfaceArea_revSurface_of_nonneg {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) {a b : ℝ} (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, 0 ≤ f x) : surfaceArea (revSurface f) a b 0 (2 * π) = 2 * π * ∫ x in a..b, f x * √(1 + deriv f x ^ 2)
decls.doc: Bản dùng khi `f ≥ 0` trên `[a, b]`: `S = 2π ∫ₐᵇ f(x) √(1 + f'(x)²) dx`.

decls.name: QuadraticMap.toContinuousMultilinearMapHalf_apply

decls.name: coercive_of_posdef_of_contdiff

decls.name: le_of_littleO
decls.sig: theorem le_of_littleO {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {f : V → ℝ} {x₀ x : V} {C : ℝ} (hx : C * (‖x - x₀‖ ^ 2) ≤ iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x₀ fun _ ↦ x - x₀) (hx₀ : fderiv ℝ f x₀ x = fderiv ℝ f x₀ x₀) (h₁ : ‖f x - ∑ i ∈ range 3, 1 / i ! * iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x₀ fun _ ↦ x - x₀‖ ≤ C / 2 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ 2) : f x₀ ≤ f x
decls.doc: If the quadratic term in the Taylor expansion of `f` at `x₀` is bounded below by `C * ‖x - x₀‖²`, the linear term vanishes, and the Taylor remainder is bounded in norm by `(C / 2) * ‖x - x₀‖²`, then `f x₀ ≤ f x`. This is the key estimate underlying the second-derivative test: a positive quadratic te

decls.name: MathExam.frechet_taylor_integral
decls.sig: theorem frechet_taylor_integral {f : E → F} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x h : E} (hf : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContDiffAt ℝ n f (x + s • h)) : f (x + h) = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((k ! : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x fun _ => h) + (((n - 1)! : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) ^ (n - 1) • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (x + s • h) fun _ => h
decls.doc: **Taylor nhiều biến, phần dư dạng tích phân**, giả thiết cục bộ trên đoạn [x, x + h] (phát biểu theo LeanArchitect, `frechet_taylor_integral`): `f (x + h) = ∑_{k<n} Dᵏf(x)(h,…,h)/k! + 1/(n-1)! ∫₀¹ (1-s)^(n-1) Dⁿf(x + s h)(h,…,h) ds`. Hệ quả trực tiếp của `map_add_eq_sum_add_integral_iteratedFDeriv`

decls.name: MathExam.frechet_taylor_integral_of_contDiff
decls.sig: theorem frechet_taylor_integral_of_contDiff {f : E → F} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hf : ContDiff ℝ n f) (x h : E) : f (x + h) = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((k ! : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x fun _ => h) + (((n - 1)! : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) ^ (n - 1) • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (x + s • h) fun _ => h
decls.doc: Bản giả thiết toàn cục `ContDiff ℝ n f` (đủ cho đa thức, hàm mũ, lượng giác).

decls.name: MathExam.taylor_integral_unit
decls.sig: theorem taylor_integral_unit {g : ℝ → F} (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hg : ContDiff ℝ n g) : g 1 = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((k ! : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ • iteratedDeriv k g 0) + (((n - 1)! : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) ^ (n - 1) • iteratedDeriv n g s
decls.doc: **Taylor một biến, phần dư dạng tích phân** trên `[0, 1]`, viết bằng đạo hàm thường: `g 1 = ∑_{k<n} g⁽ᵏ⁾(0)/k! + 1/(n-1)! ∫₀¹ (1-s)^(n-1) g⁽ⁿ⁾(s) ds`. Suy từ bản nhiều biến với `E = ℝ`, `x = 0`, `h = 1`.
